Limit price as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '61000.25'.

marketIoc.description: Market order with implicit IOC behavior.

clientRefPrice.description: Optional client reference price for the market order's slippage protection, as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '61000.25'. It need not be a multiple of the pair's price tick: only the protection price derived from it is. The protection price is the reference moved by the maximum slippage, up for a BUY and down for a SELL, then rounded onto the pair's tick grid toward the reference (a BUY's down, a SELL's up), so it never allows more than the slippage and can be up to one tick tighter. For example, with a 0.01 tick, a reference of '73840.125' and a maximum slippage of 50.12 quote units give a BUY protection price of 73890.24 and a SELL protection price of 73790.01. When omitted, admission uses server-side reference pricing. A reference too far from the server's is refused with STALE_QUOTE.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum allowed slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 10000. A SELL order accepts at most 9999: a 100% cap would leave it no positive price to sell at, so 10000 is rejected with MAX_SLIPPAGE_INVALID.

maxSlippageTicks.description: Maximum absolute price delta of the protection price from the reference price, as a positive integer in 1e-9 quote units, for example 50120000000 for 50.12. The ticks in this name are 1e-9 quote units, not the pair's price tick, and the value need not be a multiple of the pair's tick: the protection price is rounded onto the tick grid toward the reference, as clientRefPrice describes.

peg.description: Optional static peg. The selected limit execution still requires its price bound. Quote sizing, market execution and attached risk are invalid.

offsetTicks.description: Signed number of configured price increments added once at entry. The limit price is the required buy cap or sell floor.

reference.description: Required public book side. An empty selected side rejects the order.

quoteProceeds.description: Quote proceeds target before fees as a decimal string in quote asset units, for example '100'. The order sells whole quantity steps until its proceeds reach this amount, never more. Valid only for SELL market IOC and SELL limit IOC.

selfTradePreventionMode.description: Self-trade prevention mode against orders of the same root account, including all its subaccounts. Defaults to EXPIRE_MAKER if unspecified.

oco.description: If true, the take-profit and the configured stop leg (stop-loss or trailing stop) are linked and shown as one-cancels-the-other. Requires a take-profit and exactly one stop leg. The legs of every parent share one position and end together as described on RiskPolicy, so this setting does not change when exits are submitted. It decides only what canceling a leg's exit order ends: with oco set, canceling one leg's exit ends both legs; without it, only that leg ends and the other keeps protecting the remaining position. Canceling a leg itself with CancelTrigger ends only that leg either way, and the other leg stays active. Changing only this setting with ModifyOrder keeps the existing legs, with their IDs, arming and a trailing stop's tracked peak; changing a leg's terms, such as its trigger price, limit price or trailing distance, still replaces that leg. Default is false.

clientRefPrice.description: Optional client reference price for the market order's slippage protection, as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '61000.25'. It need not be a multiple of the pair's price tick: only the protection price derived from it is. The protection price is the reference moved by the maximum slippage, up for a BUY and down for a SELL, then rounded onto the pair's tick grid toward the reference (a BUY's down, a SELL's up), so it never allows more than the slippage and can be up to one tick tighter. For example, with a 0.01 tick, a reference of '73840.125' and a maximum slippage of 50.12 quote units give a BUY protection price of 73890.24 and a SELL protection price of 73790.01. When omitted, admission uses server-side reference pricing. A reference too far from the server's is refused with STALE_QUOTE.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum allowed slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 10000. A SELL order accepts at most 9999: a 100% cap would leave it no positive price to sell at, so 10000 is rejected with MAX_SLIPPAGE_INVALID.

maxSlippageTicks.description: Maximum absolute price delta of the protection price from the reference price, as a positive integer in 1e-9 quote units, for example 50120000000 for 50.12. The ticks in this name are 1e-9 quote units, not the pair's price tick, and the value need not be a multiple of the pair's tick: the protection price is rounded onto the tick grid toward the reference, as clientRefPrice describes.

isTemplate.description: True if this policy is a template: a reusable policy of the main account that is never attached to a sub-account itself. Applying it with SetSubaccountPolicy attaches a copy, so editing the template later changes no sub-account. Set when the policy is created and never changes.

locked.description: When true, this policy is write-protected and requires an elevated approval flow to modify it.

maxOpenOrders.description: Maximum number of resting orders allowed on this sub-account at any time. A value of 0 means "no explicit cap".

maxOrderNotional.description: Maximum notional of any single order on this sub-account, as a decimal string in quote asset units (USDT), for example '2500.5'. '0' means no explicit cap.

reviewAt.description: Optional review time in UTC. This is governance metadata and does not automatically disable the policy.

revision.description: Monotonic resource revision used for conditional updates.

sourceTemplateId.description: Template this policy was copied from (opaque ID), or 0 when it is not a copy. Set when the copy is made and never changes, even after the template is edited or deleted; the copy is not linked to the template.

sourceTemplateRevision.description: Revision of the template when this policy was copied from it, or 0 when it is not a copy. Compare it with the template's current revision to see whether the template changed since. Never changes.

spotMarketScope.description: Market-level scope for spot markets. When ALL, spot_markets is returned for display only and is not enforced.

spotMarkets.description: Allowed spot markets for this sub-account.

tradingHalted.description: When true, new orders and exposure-increasing order or trigger changes are rejected regardless of other settings. Existing orders and triggers may still be canceled or paused by an otherwise authorized caller.

updatedAt.description: Last update time in UTC.

product.description: Optional product filter; UNSPECIFIED means every product.

subaccountId.description: Optional public subaccount ID. When omitted, a session or main-account API key reads the main account together with every subaccount it owns, and a subaccount API key reads its own subaccount. A main-account API key may name a subaccount its main account owns.

symbolId.description: Optional market filter for markets; 0 means every market. Totals and holdings are not filtered by market.

asOf.description: When the figures were last published (UTC). Trades and transfers settled shortly before may not be included yet.

feesUsd.description: Fees paid in the period net of rebates, in USD. Signed base-10 decimal string.

holdings.description: Assets held now, ordered by asset_id.

assetId.description: Asset ID.

costUsd.description: USD cost of the quantity with a known cost: what it cost when acquired, fees in the asset included. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

entryPriceUsd.description: Average entry price in USD per unit: cost_usd divided by the quantity with a known cost. Omitted when no quantity has a known cost.

markPriceUsd.description: Current USD price per unit used for unrealized PnL. Omitted when not available.

positionQuantity.description: Quantity held, in whole units of the asset: position_quantity = quantity with a known cost plus untracked_quantity. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

unrealizedPnlUsd.description: Unrealized PnL in USD: the quantity with a known cost valued at mark_price_usd, minus cost_usd. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted when mark_price_usd is.

untrackedQuantity.description: Quantity whose cost is unknown, such as deposited coins, in whole units of the asset. It never counts toward PnL. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

markTime.description: Time of the prices that value holdings now (UTC): the close of the latest complete minute.

markets.description: Realized PnL by market, ordered by symbol_id.

feesUsd.description: Fees paid in the period, net of rebates received, in USD. Signed base-10 decimal string: negative when rebates exceed fees.

realizedPnlUsd.description: Realized PnL in USD of the period's trades, after their fees: each sale realizes its proceeds minus the average cost of what it sold, and each fee is a realized expense. Signed base-10 decimal string.

tradeCount.description: Fills of the account in the market in the period.

volumeUsd.description: Traded volume in USD: execution price times quantity, valued at the execution time. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

notices.description: What the figures leave out, if anything.

pnlUsd.description: PnL in USD over the period: realized_pnl_usd plus the change in unrealized PnL from the period's start to now, with deposits, withdrawals and transfers neutral. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted when a price it needs is not available.

feesUsd.description: Fees paid net of rebates in USD. Signed base-10 decimal string.

realizedPnlUsd.description: Realized PnL in USD of the product's trades in the period, after fees. Signed base-10 decimal string.

notices.description: What the figures leave out, if anything.

realizedPnlUsd.description: Realized PnL in USD of the period's trades, after fees. Signed base-10 decimal string.

returnDays.description: Daily returns the return figures are based on: the closed days of their period from the account's first deposit on. Today never counts.

returnPct.description: Time-weighted return in percent over closed days only: for DAYS_7 and DAYS_30, the 7 or 30 closed UTC days ending at the latest 00:00 whose prices are final; every closed day for LIFETIME; none for TODAY. The daily returns are compounded, so deposits and withdrawals do not count as gains or losses. A day's return is (end - start - flow) / (start + flow / 2) of its equity and net flow; a day that starts with no equity starts at its first deposit, with return (end - flow) / flow. Signed base-10 decimal string, such as "1.25" for 1.25%. The return figures cover the whole account, whatever symbol_id and product select. Omitted when a day's equity or net flow is not available, or when the period has no closed day.

sharpe.description: Annualized Sharpe ratio of the daily returns: their mean divided by their sample standard deviation, times the square root of 365, with no risk-free rate. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted with notice SHARPE_INSUFFICIENT_DAYS for fewer than 7 daily returns; omitted also when the returns do not vary, or as return_pct is.

tradeCount.description: Fills of the account in the period.

volumeUsd.description: Traded volume in USD. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

endTime.description: Day after the last one (UTC), exclusive: 00:00 UTC of a day, at most 366 days after start_time.

limit.description: Maximum days to return; 0 means 31. At most 366.

pageToken.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and bound to the authenticated account, the subaccount selector, start_time and end_time.

feesUsd.description: Fees paid in the day net of rebates, in USD. Signed base-10 decimal string.

netFlowUsd.description: Net external flows of the day in USD: deposits and transfers in, minus withdrawals and transfers out, each valued at the USD price when it settled. Transfers between the main account and its own subaccounts count for a single subaccount and cancel out for the main account. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted when a price it needs is not available.

notices.description: What the day's figures leave out, if anything.

realizedPnlUsd.description: Realized PnL in USD of the day's trades, after fees. Signed base-10 decimal string.

startEquityUsd.description: Equity in USD at 00:00 UTC that starts the day: every asset the account owns, funds reserved by open orders and pending withdrawals included, valued at the price at that time. Omitted with notice EQUITY_UNAVAILABLE when a price it needs is not available, or after a day with notice UNCLASSIFIED_TRANSFER or QUANTITY_SHORTFALL.

title.description: Short summary: the HTTP status text.

status.description: Whether new QuickSwaps can name the vault.

address.description: Deposit address in the source network's native text form, without memo.

addressRetiresAt.description: After this time the deposit address is retired, and a deposit sent to it later never executes. One that Polyester records on this QuickSwap is listed in deposits as RETURN_ONLY (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED): it is returned to return_address when it can be, and its direct_return reports whether it was. One the network refuses before Polyester records it is not listed in deposits, and nothing on any QuickSwap reports it or its return; report its transaction to Polyester broker support with the swap_id. For an unfunded address it equals funding_expires_at. After a deposit is accepted it is provisional, a lower bound, until Polyester releases the deposit address, which can be shortly after the QuickSwap becomes terminal; from then on it is at least 7 days after all payouts finish. It only moves later, never earlier, and never before funding_expires_at.

addressState.description: Current lifecycle state of the address.

fundingExpiresAt.description: End of the funding window, fixed when the address is issued (currently 7 days after issued_at). A deposit can execute only if Polyester detects it before this time; detection time counts, not block time, and confirmations may finish later. A deposit detected at or after this time never executes; it is RETURN_ONLY, and so is a deposit observed after the address retired. For an unfunded address, address_retires_at equals this time, so there is no separate scheduled return period. Send deposits well before this time. Never changes.

issuedAt.description: When the address was issued to this QuickSwap; the funding window starts here. After ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE it can be long after created_at.

memo.description: Destination tag or memo the deposit must carry; empty when the source network uses none. A deposit without it cannot be attributed.

minNativeGasLimit.description: Recommended gas limit, in gas units, for a native-coin deposit on EVM networks to succeed reliably: 250000. Polyester does not enforce it; the sender's wallet or exchange sets the gas limit. A gas estimate from the network of at least 50000 also works, but confirms more slowly. The gas a plain transfer needs differs by network: several layer-2 networks and EVM forks do not use 21000. If the limit is too low, the transfer fails on chain without depositing, and the network fee is still charged. Zero for token deposits and non-EVM networks.

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network to deposit; equal to terms.source_zipped_asset_id.

depositedValueUsd.description: USD value of the credited deposit taken into execution (execution.input_amount), at the source asset's USD price when it was taken in, in base units of 18 decimals, rounded down. Set once, within minutes of that moment, and never repriced. Unset until then, and for good when no current price valued it in time or the QuickSwap predates USD values; never zero for unknown. isTerminal.description: True when status is terminal; authoritative, including for status values added later. Polling can stop at a terminal status. A terminal status never changes. Shortly after it, address_retires_at can still move later, and withdrawal details can be corrected as documented on Withdrawal; another deposit reaching the address, before or after it retired, also shows as RETURN_ONLY. Such a deposit is returned directly, not through withdrawals: its direct_return reports the return, and RETURN_ONLY alone does not confirm a completed return. An EXPIRED QuickSwap whose dropped or replaced deposit confirms after all becomes HELD (see QuickSwapStatus.EXPIRED). Read again if the end user reports such a deposit or needs the final retirement time.

For a bridge, min_deposit_amount often equals the source network's minimum deposit; when they are equal, any smaller deposit is lost. It differs from ErrorDetail.min_deposit_amount, the smallest deposit that currently quotes. For a TWAP it is the slice count times the smallest deposit one slice takes, and at least a market execution's minimum. The deposit network fee is charged on the actual deposit and can exceed the quoted one: a bridge deposit of at least this amount whose credit after that fee is below one base unit of the destination token is also not executed (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM, see that reason for how its return ends).

title.description: Short summary: the HTTP status text.

type.description: URI identifying the problem type: https://polyester.dev/problems/ followed by code in lowercase, with hyphens for underscores, for example https://polyester.dev/problems/rate-limit-exceeded for RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

affiliates.description: Affiliate fees, each charged on top and credited to its affiliate vault: at most three distinct vaults. Fixed at creation with broker_bps.

accountId.description: Public sub-account ID of an active affiliate vault of the broker (QuickSwapBrokerService.CreateAffiliateVault). Create the vault first: an unknown, disabled or other broker's vault, or the default vault, fails with AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN; an ID that is not a public sub-account ID fails with FEES_INVALID.

bps.description: Fee in basis points of what each leg receives, from 1 to 300.

brokerBps.description: Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, charged on top of the service fee and credited to the broker's default vault; 0 for none, at most 300. broker_bps and the affiliates' bps total at most 300.

destinationAddress.description: Recipient of the swap output on the destination network, in its native text form without memo: 1-256 UTF-8 bytes.

destinationMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for destination_address. Required when the destination network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported. See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

idempotencyKey.description: Broker-chosen idempotency key, 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-'. Scoped to the authenticated broker and retained permanently. The same key with the same request returns the same QuickSwap and deposit address; with a different request it fails with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Requests are compared after every valid address and memo is put in its network's canonical form, so the same address in another case or encoding is the same request; affiliate order is ignored; every other field, the fees included, must be equal.

referralCode.description: Optional referral partner code from a referral link, case-insensitive, at most 64 bytes; empty for none. Only a broker with a referral program may send one (REFERRAL_NOT_SUPPORTED otherwise), never with affiliates. It must be a valid code (REFERRAL_CODE_INVALID) that is a partner's code (REFERRAL_CODE_UNKNOWN), and the partner must be active (REFERRAL_PARTNER_INACTIVE). A code the partner has since replaced with SetReferralCode keeps crediting that partner. The program's current rates for the route are applied (quote.referral) and fixed at creation. It is part of the request: the same idempotency_key with another code, or with and without one, is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

refundAddress.description: Recipient of refunded intermediate asset on the refund route's network, in its native text form without memo. At most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

refundMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for refund_address. Required when the refund network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported. See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

refundZippedAssetId.description: Refund route for the intermediate asset of a two-leg route: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id of the asset whose AssetConfig.ledger_id is the quote's intermediate_asset_id in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config, for example USDT on Ethereum. Required with refund_address when the route has an intermediate asset; optional and unused otherwise.

returnAddress.description: Recipient of returned source funds on the source network, in its native text form without memo: 1-256 UTF-8 bytes. Deposits that are not accepted, and source funds that are not traded, go here; never to an observed sender.

returnMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for return_address. Required when the source network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported. See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

sourceWallet.description: Optional source wallet the end user will deposit from, for brokers that know it in advance. It must be a valid address on the source network, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, and is shown on the QuickSwap. It is risk screened before the deposit address is issued: a wallet that fails screening makes the QuickSwap REJECTED, bound to the key, without a deposit address, and the request and every repeat of it fail with SOURCE_WALLET_REJECTED. Source wallets are screened in advance on Bitcoin, Solana and most EVM networks. Wallets on other networks, including the Bitcoin and Solana test networks, and wallets whose screening is unavailable at the time, get their address without it. Every deposit is still screened on arrival, so a deposit sent from another wallet is judged on its own sender.

execution.description: Market or TWAP execution. A bridge trades nothing and takes market only; TWAP on a bridge is ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.

protection.description: Worst execution the end user accepts.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

depositInstructions.description: Where and until when to deposit; absent while ALLOCATING and on a QuickSwap that never got an address (REJECTED, or EXPIRED with DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT).

address.description: Deposit address in the source network's native text form, without memo.

addressRetiresAt.description: After this time the deposit address is retired, and a deposit sent to it later never executes. One that Polyester records on this QuickSwap is listed in deposits as RETURN_ONLY (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED): it is returned to return_address when it can be, and its direct_return reports whether it was. One the network refuses before Polyester records it is not listed in deposits, and nothing on any QuickSwap reports it or its return; report its transaction to Polyester broker support with the swap_id. For an unfunded address it equals funding_expires_at. After a deposit is accepted it is provisional, a lower bound, until Polyester releases the deposit address, which can be shortly after the QuickSwap becomes terminal; from then on it is at least 7 days after all payouts finish. It only moves later, never earlier, and never before funding_expires_at.

addressState.description: Current lifecycle state of the address.

fundingExpiresAt.description: End of the funding window, fixed when the address is issued (currently 7 days after issued_at). A deposit can execute only if Polyester detects it before this time; detection time counts, not block time, and confirmations may finish later. A deposit detected at or after this time never executes; it is RETURN_ONLY, and so is a deposit observed after the address retired. For an unfunded address, address_retires_at equals this time, so there is no separate scheduled return period. Send deposits well before this time. Never changes.

issuedAt.description: When the address was issued to this QuickSwap; the funding window starts here. After ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE it can be long after created_at.

memo.description: Destination tag or memo the deposit must carry; empty when the source network uses none. A deposit without it cannot be attributed.

minNativeGasLimit.description: Recommended gas limit, in gas units, for a native-coin deposit on EVM networks to succeed reliably: 250000. Polyester does not enforce it; the sender's wallet or exchange sets the gas limit. A gas estimate from the network of at least 50000 also works, but confirms more slowly. The gas a plain transfer needs differs by network: several layer-2 networks and EVM forks do not use 21000. If the limit is too low, the transfer fails on chain without depositing, and the network fee is still charged. Zero for token deposits and non-EVM networks.

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network to deposit; equal to terms.source_zipped_asset_id.

depositedValueUsd.description: USD value of the credited deposit taken into execution (execution.input_amount), at the source asset's USD price when it was taken in, in base units of 18 decimals, rounded down. Set once, within minutes of that moment, and never repriced. Unset until then, and for good when no current price valued it in time or the QuickSwap predates USD values; never zero for unknown. Setting it increments version.

amount.description: Received amount, before the deposit network fee, in zipped_asset_id's token units; unset while zipped_asset_id is zero.

confirmations.description: Current source-network confirmations; zero until the source network reports any. Never decreases.

creditedAt.description: When the deposit was credited; unset until credited. Credit does not decide eligibility: a credited deposit can still be EVALUATING, and one then found ineligible, such as a late deposit, stays credited and is returned (RETURN_ONLY).

detectedAt.description: When the deposit was first seen. Eligibility compares this time with funding_expires_at.

directReturn.description: Direct return to return_address of a deposit that was never credited: a RETURN_ONLY deposit that reached the address after its one eligible deposit, after its funding window or after the address retired. Unset until a direct return is recorded, and on every other deposit, which is returned through withdrawals.

state.description: Return progress. Accept state values added later.

txHash.description: Return transaction on the deposit's network, in the network's native text form; set only once RETURN_COMPLETED, and then never changes.

updatedAt.description: When the return last changed state.

flowId.description: Public, URL-safe lifecycle flow identifier of this deposit, usable with GET /v1/chain/flows/{flow_id}; empty until the flow exists. Lifecycle flow amounts are 18-decimal unified units (amount_e18), not token base units.

index.description: Zero-based position in deposits, which lists deposits oldest first. Not stable: a deposit detected earlier can appear later, for example a dropped or replaced deposit that confirms after all, and then shifts the index of every deposit after it. Identify a deposit by tx_hash with tx_occurrence_index, not by index.

networkFee.description: Deposit network fee that Zipper withheld from this deposit when it took the deposit in, in zipped_asset_id's token units; zero when it charged none. Unset until Zipper has taken the deposit in, and on a deposit it never takes in: a deposit returned or transferred out without being credited, whose deductions are not reported.

requiredConfirmations.description: Source-network confirmations required before credit; zero until known.

txHash.description: Source-network transaction identifier in the network's native text form.

txOccurrenceIndex.description: Output or log index of the deposit within tx_hash; zero is valid.

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network actually received, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero until Polyester has identified the deposit's asset, shortly after detection, and when the asset is not a supported route.

depositsTruncated.description: True when more than 50 deposits were detected; only the first 50 are listed.

destinationAddress.description: Recipient of the swap output on the destination network. Addresses and memos are in their network's canonical form (for example lowercase EVM hex), which can differ in case or encoding from the create request; that form is the one paid.

destinationMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for destination_address; empty when none.

execution.description: Execution progress; absent before execution starts.

completedSlices.description: Completed slices: a market execution's one slice completes when execution finishes; a TWAP slice completes once it has traded and is over, so a slot that traded nothing or was skipped never completes. Zero for a bridge.

executedInput.description: Source amount traded so far, in source token units. On a two-leg route this counts the first leg. Zero for a bridge, which trades nothing.

startedAt.description: First actual slice submission. Omitted while every slice is unsent, including refusal during planning; planned times and deadline do not imply submission.

totalSlices.description: Planned slices: a market execution has one once it is planned; a TWAP has its slice count, duration_ms over slice_interval_ms rounded up. Zero until then, and for a bridge, which trades nothing.

feeScheduleVersion.description: Fee schedule version fixed at creation. Every execution or bridge payout of this QuickSwap is charged that version's service fees, capped by the broker's fee ceiling in force at creation if one applies, whatever later versions or ceiling changes make.

fees.description: Broker and affiliate fees as requested, fixed at creation. With a referral (quote.referral), the broker fee charged is broker_bps less the referral's discount and commission.

affiliates.description: Affiliate fees, in ascending account_id order.

accountId.description: Public sub-account ID of an active affiliate vault of the broker (QuickSwapBrokerService.CreateAffiliateVault). Create the vault first: an unknown, disabled or other broker's vault, or the default vault, fails with AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN; an ID that is not a public sub-account ID fails with FEES_INVALID.

bps.description: Fee in basis points of what each leg receives, from 1 to 300.

brokerBps.description: Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, credited to the broker's default vault.

idempotencyKey.description: The broker's idempotency key that created this QuickSwap.

isTerminal.description: True when status is terminal; authoritative, including for status values added later. Polling can stop at a terminal status. A terminal status never changes. Shortly after it, address_retires_at can still move later, and withdrawal details can be corrected as documented on Withdrawal; another deposit reaching the address, before or after it retired, also shows as RETURN_ONLY. Such a deposit is returned directly, not through withdrawals: its direct_return reports the return, and RETURN_ONLY alone does not confirm a completed return. An EXPIRED QuickSwap whose dropped or replaced deposit confirms after all becomes HELD (see QuickSwapStatus.EXPIRED). Read again if the end user reports such a deposit or needs the final retirement time.

quote.description: Quote and protection fixed at creation. Not refreshed on retries. Its amounts and fees stay estimates: the QuickSwap is priced when its deposit is credited, and execution, withdrawals and charged_fees report the actual output and fees.

contingentFees.description: Estimated network fees charged only if funds are not delivered: RETURN_NETWORK, then REFUND_NETWORK when the refund route is known. Not part of fees or expected_amount_out. A partly traded two-leg QuickSwap can be charged both. The fee withheld is the network's fee at payout time. Unlike fees, an entry is never omitted: a known fee of zero is listed with amount "0".

accountId.description: AFFILIATE only: public sub-account ID of the affiliate vault credited with the fee; zero for every other kind, REFERRAL included.

amount.description: Fee in zipped_asset_id's token units; for a trading fee of the first leg of a two-leg route, in the intermediate asset at its trading precision (amount.decimals). A REFUND_NETWORK fee, though paid in the intermediate asset, is in the refund route's token units and precision (0.72 USDT on a 6-decimal route is 720000 with decimals 6). An estimate for deposit_amount at the quoted prices, with trading fees rounded up; the fee charged can be higher or lower.

CreateQuickSwap prices the terms again and never fails because a quote expired. After it the price fields are stale; the protection of a created QuickSwap still applies. Independent of the funding window and the execution deadline.

Affiliates are in ascending account_id order. Zero fees are omitted. The fees charged are each rate applied to the actual execution and can differ from these amounts; QuickSwap.charged_fees reports the service, broker, affiliate and referral fees as charged, and Deposit.network_fee and Withdrawal.network_fee the network fees.

For any other deposit, and for a deposit only partly converted, the guarantee is min_rate on the converted part.

minDepositAmount.description: Published minimum deposit, in source token units, compared with the deposit before its network fee. Send at least this amount. It is never below the source network's minimum deposit (AssetChainVariant.deposit_min_amount in the config, for DepositInstructions.zipped_asset_id). A smaller deposit is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM) only if it reaches the source network's minimum deposit; a deposit below that minimum is not detected, recorded or returned, and is lost. For a bridge, min_deposit_amount often equals the source network's minimum deposit; when they are equal, any smaller deposit is lost. It differs from ErrorDetail.min_deposit_amount, the smallest deposit that currently quotes. For a TWAP it is the slice count times the smallest deposit one slice takes, and at least a market execution's minimum. The deposit network fee is charged on the actual deposit and can exceed the quoted one: a bridge deposit of at least this amount whose credit after that fee is below one base unit of the destination token is also not executed (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM, see that reason for how its return ends).

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

minRate.description: Guaranteed minimum execution rate: destination display units per source display unit, as a decimal string with at most 18 fractional digits, rounded up when quoted. Guarantee: for the source amount converted all the way to the destination asset, the destination output before the withdrawal network fee is at least that amount × min_rate, rounded down to destination token units. On a two-leg route, the source amount converted is the first leg's input in proportion to the intermediate funds the second leg converted. Source that is not traded is returned to return_address, and intermediate funds that the second leg does not convert are refunded in the intermediate asset to refund_address; those parts are outside the destination guarantee. The amount delivered is the output less the actual withdrawal network fee, which can differ from the quote.

referral.description: The referral applied; set only when the request carried a referral_code. A QuickSwap's quote keeps the referral fixed at creation: later changes to the referral program or partner never change it.

baseBrokerBps.description: Broker fee without the referral: the request's broker_bps.

commissionBps.description: Commission credited to the referral partner.

discountBps.description: Discount off the end user's fee.

reason.description: Why the status is notable (held, returning, delayed, terminal without destination output); REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise. When a payout completes but a refund or return was NOT_SENT, the status follows the paid withdrawals (for example COMPLETED) and the reason is REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM. A FAILED withdrawal takes precedence: the status is HELD and the reason WITHDRAWAL_FAILED.

refundAddress.description: Recipient of refunded intermediate asset; empty when none was supplied.

addressRetiresAt.description: After this time the deposit address is retired, and a deposit sent to it later never executes. One that Polyester records on this QuickSwap is listed in deposits as RETURN_ONLY (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED): it is returned to return_address when it can be, and its direct_return reports whether it was. One the network refuses before Polyester records it is not listed in deposits, and nothing on any QuickSwap reports it or its return; report its transaction to Polyester broker support with the swap_id. For an unfunded address it equals funding_expires_at. After a deposit is accepted it is provisional, a lower bound, until Polyester releases the deposit address, which can be shortly after the QuickSwap becomes terminal; from then on it is at least 7 days after all payouts finish. It only moves later, never earlier, and never before funding_expires_at.

A deposit detected at or after this time never executes; it is RETURN_ONLY, and so is a deposit observed after the address retired. For an unfunded address, address_retires_at equals this time, so there is no separate scheduled return period. Send deposits well before this time. Never changes.

minNativeGasLimit.description: Recommended gas limit, in gas units, for a native-coin deposit on EVM networks to succeed reliably: 250000. The gas a plain transfer needs differs by network: several layer-2 networks and EVM forks do not use 21000. If the limit is too low, the transfer fails on chain without depositing, and the network fee is still charged. Zero for token deposits and non-EVM networks.

isTerminal.description: True when status is terminal; authoritative, including for status values added later. Polling can stop at a terminal status. A terminal status never changes. Such a deposit is returned directly, not through withdrawals: its direct_return reports the return, and RETURN_ONLY alone does not confirm a completed return. An EXPIRED QuickSwap whose dropped or replaced deposit confirms after all becomes HELD (see QuickSwapStatus.EXPIRED). Read again if the end user reports such a deposit or needs the final retirement time.

quote.description: Quote and protection fixed at creation. Not refreshed on retries. Its amounts and fees stay estimates: the QuickSwap is priced when its deposit is credited, and execution, withdrawals and charged_fees report the actual output and fees.

contingentFees.description: Estimated network fees charged only if funds are not delivered: RETURN_NETWORK, then REFUND_NETWORK when the refund route is known. Not part of fees or expected_amount_out. A partly traded two-leg QuickSwap can be charged both. The fee withheld is the network's fee at payout time. Unlike fees, an entry is never omitted: a known fee of zero is listed with amount "0".

accountId.description: AFFILIATE only: public sub-account ID of the affiliate vault credited with the fee; zero for every other kind, REFERRAL included.

amount.description: Fee in zipped_asset_id's token units; for a trading fee of the first leg of a two-leg route, in the intermediate asset at its trading precision (amount.decimals). A REFUND_NETWORK fee, though paid in the intermediate asset, is in the refund route's token units and precision (0.72 USDT on a 6-decimal route is 720000 with decimals 6). An estimate for deposit_amount at the quoted prices, with trading fees rounded up; the fee charged can be higher or lower.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

bps.description: Rate of a trading fee in basis points of what the leg receives; zero for a network fee. The rate, not amount, is what is charged: bps of what the leg actually receives.

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network the fee is charged in, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero for a trading fee of the first leg of a two-leg route, which is charged in the intermediate asset (intermediate_asset_id).

depositAmount.description: Source amount the quote was computed for, in source token units. Equals the request amount for SOURCE_AMOUNT; computed for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

expectedAmountOut.description: Expected destination amount for deposit_amount at quoted_at, after trading fees and both quoted network fees, in destination token units. An estimate, not a guarantee: the delivered amount follows the actual deposit, execution and fees, bounded below only by the protection.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

expiresAt.description: End of the short quote validity, typically seconds to minutes after quoted_at. Display the quote until expires_at. CreateQuickSwap prices the terms again and never fails because a quote expired. After it the price fields are stale; the protection of a created QuickSwap still applies. Independent of the funding window and the execution deadline.

fees.description: Estimated fee components for deposit_amount at quoted_at: each leg's service, broker and affiliate or referral fees, in that order, legs in route order (a bridge has one set, charged at payout), then network fees. Affiliates are in ascending account_id order. Zero fees are omitted. The fees charged are each rate applied to the actual execution and can differ from these amounts; QuickSwap.charged_fees reports the service, broker, affiliate and referral fees as charged, and Deposit.network_fee and Withdrawal.network_fee the network fees.

accountId.description: AFFILIATE only: public sub-account ID of the affiliate vault credited with the fee; zero for every other kind, REFERRAL included.

A REFUND_NETWORK fee, though paid in the intermediate asset, is in the refund route's token units and precision (0.72 USDT on a 6-decimal route is 720000 with decimals 6). An estimate for deposit_amount at the quoted prices, with trading fees rounded up; the fee charged can be higher or lower.

bps.description: Rate of a trading fee in basis points of what the leg receives; zero for a network fee. The rate, not amount, is what is charged: bps of what the leg actually receives.

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network the fee is charged in, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero for a trading fee of the first leg of a two-leg route, which is charged in the intermediate asset (intermediate_asset_id).

intermediateAssetId.description: Unified asset ID of the intermediate asset of a two-leg route (for example USDT for BTC to SOL): the AssetConfig.ledger_id from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. Zero for a direct route or a bridge. When non-zero, CreateQuickSwap requires a refund address for that asset. The route is fixed at creation.

maxDepositAmount.description: Largest deposit that is eligible to execute, in source token units, compared with the deposit before its network fee. Fixed when the QuickSwap is created. A larger deposit is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM). Unset for a bridge, whose deposit no order book bounds.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

minAmountOut.description: Guaranteed minimum delivered amount, in destination token units, at the quoted network fees, for a deposit of exactly deposit_amount that fully converts to the destination asset. For any other deposit, and for a deposit only partly converted, the guarantee is min_rate on the converted part.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

minDepositAmount.description: Published minimum deposit, in source token units, compared with the deposit before its network fee. Send at least this amount. It is never below the source network's minimum deposit (AssetChainVariant.deposit_min_amount in the config, for DepositInstructions.zipped_asset_id). A smaller deposit is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM) only if it reaches the source network's minimum deposit; a deposit below that minimum is not detected, recorded or returned, and is lost. For a bridge, min_deposit_amount often equals the source network's minimum deposit; when they are equal, any smaller deposit is lost. It differs from ErrorDetail.min_deposit_amount, the smallest deposit that currently quotes. For a TWAP it is the slice count times the smallest deposit one slice takes, and at least a market execution's minimum. The deposit network fee is charged on the actual deposit and can exceed the quoted one: a bridge deposit of at least this amount whose credit after that fee is below one base unit of the destination token is also not executed (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM, see that reason for how its return ends).

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

minRate.description: Guaranteed minimum execution rate: destination display units per source display unit, as a decimal string with at most 18 fractional digits, rounded up when quoted. Guarantee: for the source amount converted all the way to the destination asset, the destination output before the withdrawal network fee is at least that amount × min_rate, rounded down to destination token units. On a two-leg route, the source amount converted is the first leg's input in proportion to the intermediate funds the second leg converted. Source that is not traded is returned to return_address, and intermediate funds that the second leg does not convert are refunded in the intermediate asset to refund_address; those parts are outside the destination guarantee. The amount delivered is the output less the actual withdrawal network fee, which can differ from the quote.

referral.description: The referral applied; set only when the request carried a referral_code. A QuickSwap's quote keeps the referral fixed at creation: later changes to the referral program or partner never change it.

baseBrokerBps.description: Broker fee without the referral: the request's broker_bps.

commissionBps.description: Commission credited to the referral partner.

discountBps.description: Discount off the end user's fee.

reason.description: Why the status is notable (held, returning, delayed, terminal without destination output); REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise. When a payout completes but a refund or return was NOT_SENT, the status follows the paid withdrawals (for example COMPLETED) and the reason is REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM. A FAILED withdrawal takes precedence: the status is HELD and the reason WITHDRAWAL_FAILED.

refundAddress.description: Recipient of refunded intermediate asset; empty when none was supplied.

refundMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for refund_address; empty when none.

refundZippedAssetId.description: Refund route (asset and network) of the intermediate asset; zero when none was supplied.

returnAddress.description: Recipient of returned source funds on the source network.

returnMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for return_address; empty when none.

sourceWallet.description: Source wallet supplied in the request; empty when none was supplied.

terminalAt.description: When status became terminal; unset while not terminal.

amount.description: Positive amount in the token units of the route selected by basis: source route for SOURCE_AMOUNT, destination route for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

basis.description: Side of the swap that amount denominates.

destinationZippedAssetId.description: Destination asset and network: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. The end user receives this asset on this network.

execution.description: Market or TWAP execution. A bridge trades nothing and takes market only; TWAP on a bridge is ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.

durationMs.description: Total execution duration in milliseconds, from 60000 (1 minute) to 86400000 (24 hours). The duration starts when execution starts, not when the QuickSwap is created.

sliceIntervalMs.description: Interval between slices in milliseconds, from 10000 (10 seconds) up to duration_ms. The slice count is duration_ms / slice_interval_ms, rounded up.

protection.description: Worst execution the end user accepts.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum shortfall from the quoted expected output in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 1000. Converted at creation into the quote's min_amount_out and min_rate.

minAmountOut.description: Positive minimum destination amount after fees for the quoted deposit amount, in destination token units. Converted at creation into the quote's min_rate.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

sourceZippedAssetId.description: Source asset and network: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. The end user deposits this asset on this network.

updatedAt.description: When the QuickSwap last changed.

version.description: Monotonic state version: a snapshot with a lower version is older. Zero while ALLOCATING; 1 once the deposit address is issued (AWAITING_DEPOSIT), allocation ends without one (EXPIRED with DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT) or the QuickSwap is REJECTED; every later change increments it.

address.description: Recipient address in the network's native text form. Empty on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, whose recipient Polyester does not record.

amount.description: Amount delivered to address after the network fee, in zipped_asset_id's token units; set once FINALIZED. Like tx_hash, it is the amount recorded for this withdrawal and can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends (terminal_at). Unset on the RETURN of a deposit returned because its risk screen failed (SOURCE_SCREENING_FAILED): that return is sent from the deposit address and reports no delivered amount. Unset on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER too.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

depositIndex.description: Index (Deposit.index), in the same response, of the deposit whose funds this withdrawal moves. Not stable across reads, like Deposit.index.

finalizedAt.description: When the withdrawal became final; unset until FINALIZED.

flowId.description: Public, URL-safe lifecycle flow identifier of this withdrawal, usable with GET /v1/chain/flows/{flow_id}; empty until the flow exists. The flow is the authoritative, latest state of the transfer, including a correction made after tx_hash, amount and network_fee stop being updated. Lifecycle flow amounts are 18-decimal unified units (amount_e18), not token base units. For the RETURN of a deposit returned because its risk screen failed, it is the deposit's flow (Deposit.flow_id), which ends REFUNDED with the return as its transaction. For a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, it is the deposit's flow too, which ends FAILED with reason ZIPPER_COMPLIANCE_TRANSFERRED and the transfer as its transaction.

index.description: Zero-based position in the withdrawals list. Not stable: a withdrawal's position can change between reads, so do not use it as an identifier.

memo.description: Recipient destination tag or memo; empty when the network uses none, and on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER.

networkFee.description: Actual network fee withheld from this withdrawal, in the same units; set once FINALIZED. Can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends, like amount. Unset on the RETURN of a deposit returned because its risk screen failed, and on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, like amount.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

role.description: Why this withdrawal pays its recipient.

submittedAt.description: When the withdrawal was submitted; unset until submitted.

txHash.description: Recipient-network transaction recorded for this withdrawal; empty until the transaction is committed on the recipient network. It can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends (terminal_at) and is not updated after that. For the authoritative, latest state of the transfer, read flow_id.

unsentAmount.description: Set only when state is NOT_SENT: the amount for which no withdrawal was made because it was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and network. In zipped_asset_id's token units, rounded down to the token's smallest unit.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network paid, as a zipped_asset_id.

withdrawalsTruncated.description: True when more than 50 withdrawals exist; only the first 50 are listed.

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key used to create it; resolves a QuickSwap whose create outcome was unknown.

chargedFees.description: Service, broker, affiliate and referral fees charged so far, as settled: one entry per fee kind, credited account and asset, SERVICE first, then BROKER, then AFFILIATE and REFERRAL by account_id, each kind and account by asset_id. Grows while the QuickSwap executes or pays out a bridge. Each is the rate applied to the actual execution, so it can differ from the quote's fee lines. The SERVICE entries are Polyester's fee, not an amount credited to the broker: the broker's earnings are its BROKER and AFFILIATE entries.

accountId.description: Public sub-account ID of the credited vault: the default vault for BROKER, the affiliate vault for AFFILIATE; zero for SERVICE, credited to Polyester, and for REFERRAL.

amount.description: Amount charged, in base units of 18 decimals.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

assetId.description: Asset credited, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

valueUsd.description: USD value of amount, each fee summed in it valued at its asset's USD price when it was charged, in base units of 18 decimals, rounded down. Each fee is valued once, within minutes of being charged, and never repriced. Unset while any fee summed in amount has no USD value: one charged in the last few minutes, one no current price valued in time, or one charged before USD values existed; never zero for unknown.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

deliveredValueUsd.description: USD value of what the destination is paid (the DESTINATION withdrawal's amount: after service, broker and affiliate fees, before its network fee), at the destination asset's USD price when that payout was requested, in base units of 18 decimals, rounded down. Set only once that withdrawal is FINALIZED; unset for good when no current price valued the payout within minutes of its request or the QuickSwap predates USD values; never zero for unknown.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

depositInstructions.description: Where and until when to deposit; absent while ALLOCATING and on a QuickSwap that never got an address (REJECTED, or EXPIRED with DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT).

address.description: Deposit address in the source network's native text form, without memo.

addressRetiresAt.description: After this time the deposit address is retired, and a deposit sent to it later never executes. One that Polyester records on this QuickSwap is listed in deposits as RETURN_ONLY (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED): it is returned to return_address when it can be, and its direct_return reports whether it was. One the network refuses before Polyester records it is not listed in deposits, and nothing on any QuickSwap reports it or its return; report its transaction to Polyester broker support with the swap_id. For an unfunded address it equals funding_expires_at. After a deposit is accepted it is provisional, a lower bound, until Polyester releases the deposit address, which can be shortly after the QuickSwap becomes terminal; from then on it is at least 7 days after all payouts finish. It only moves later, never earlier, and never before funding_expires_at.

addressState.description: Current lifecycle state of the address.

fundingExpiresAt.description: End of the funding window, fixed when the address is issued (currently 7 days after issued_at). A deposit can execute only if Polyester detects it before this time; detection time counts, not block time, and confirmations may finish later. A deposit detected at or after this time never executes; it is RETURN_ONLY, and so is a deposit observed after the address retired. For an unfunded address, address_retires_at equals this time, so there is no separate scheduled return period. Send deposits well before this time. Never changes.

issuedAt.description: When the address was issued to this QuickSwap; the funding window starts here. After ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE it can be long after created_at.

memo.description: Destination tag or memo the deposit must carry; empty when the source network uses none. A deposit without it cannot be attributed.

minNativeGasLimit.description: Recommended gas limit, in gas units, for a native-coin deposit on EVM networks to succeed reliably: 250000. Polyester does not enforce it; the sender's wallet or exchange sets the gas limit. A gas estimate from the network of at least 50000 also works, but confirms more slowly. The gas a plain transfer needs differs by network: several layer-2 networks and EVM forks do not use 21000. If the limit is too low, the transfer fails on chain without depositing, and the network fee is still charged. Zero for token deposits and non-EVM networks.

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network to deposit; equal to terms.source_zipped_asset_id.

depositedValueUsd.description: USD value of the credited deposit taken into execution (execution.input_amount), at the source asset's USD price when it was taken in, in base units of 18 decimals, rounded down. Set once, within minutes of that moment, and never repriced. Unset until then, and for good when no current price valued it in time or the QuickSwap predates USD values; never zero for unknown. Setting it increments version.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

deposits.description: Detected deposits, oldest first, at most 50. A deposit detected earlier can appear later and shift the others' index (see Deposit.index).

amount.description: Received amount, before the deposit network fee, in zipped_asset_id's token units; unset while zipped_asset_id is zero.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

confirmations.description: Current source-network confirmations; zero until the source network reports any. Never decreases.

creditedAt.description: When the deposit was credited; unset until credited. Credit does not decide eligibility: a credited deposit can still be EVALUATING, and one then found ineligible, such as a late deposit, stays credited and is returned (RETURN_ONLY).

detectedAt.description: When the deposit was first seen. Eligibility compares this time with funding_expires_at.

directReturn.description: Direct return to return_address of a deposit that was never credited: a RETURN_ONLY deposit that reached the address after its one eligible deposit, after its funding window or after the address retired. Unset until a direct return is recorded, and on every other deposit, which is returned through withdrawals.

state.description: Return progress. Accept state values added later.

txHash.description: Return transaction on the deposit's network, in the network's native text form; set only once RETURN_COMPLETED, and then never changes.

updatedAt.description: When the return last changed state.

flowId.description: Public, URL-safe lifecycle flow identifier of this deposit, usable with GET /v1/chain/flows/{flow_id}; empty until the flow exists. Lifecycle flow amounts are 18-decimal unified units (amount_e18), not token base units.

index.description: Zero-based position in deposits, which lists deposits oldest first. Not stable: a deposit detected earlier can appear later, for example a dropped or replaced deposit that confirms after all, and then shifts the index of every deposit after it. Identify a deposit by tx_hash with tx_occurrence_index, not by index.

networkFee.description: Deposit network fee that Zipper withheld from this deposit when it took the deposit in, in zipped_asset_id's token units; zero when it charged none. Unset until Zipper has taken the deposit in, and on a deposit it never takes in: a deposit returned or transferred out without being credited, whose deductions are not reported.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

reason.description: Why the disposition is RETURN_ONLY or ON_HOLD; REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise, and for a deposit ON_HOLD for review without a more specific reason.

requiredConfirmations.description: Source-network confirmations required before credit; zero until known.

txHash.description: Source-network transaction identifier in the network's native text form.

txOccurrenceIndex.description: Output or log index of the deposit within tx_hash; zero is valid.

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network actually received, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero until Polyester has identified the deposit's asset, shortly after detection, and when the asset is not a supported route.

depositsTruncated.description: True when more than 50 deposits were detected; only the first 50 are listed.

destinationAddress.description: Recipient of the swap output on the destination network. Addresses and memos are in their network's canonical form (for example lowercase EVM hex), which can differ in case or encoding from the create request; that form is the one paid.

execution.description: Execution progress; absent before execution starts.

completedSlices.description: Completed slices: a market execution's one slice completes when execution finishes; a TWAP slice completes once it has traded and is over, so a slot that traded nothing or was skipped never completes. Zero for a bridge.

deadline.description: Deadline frozen from the planning window; a later first slice submission does not move it.

executedInput.description: Source amount traded so far, in source token units. On a two-leg route this counts the first leg. Zero for a bridge, which trades nothing.

slices.description: Planned slices in increasing index order, at most 50. Includes future and active slices. Empty for a bridge, or when slices_unavailable_reason is set. When available and not truncated, input_traded and output_received sum to executed_input and output_amount respectively; completed entries count to completed_slices and the list has total_slices entries. Amounts are rounded cumulatively in index order.

averagePrice.description: Net destination tokens per source token for this slot, rounded down to 18 decimal places; empty when no source input traded. A two-leg slot's output can include conversion of funds carried from previous slots.

carryReason.description: Why intermediate funds could not be converted in this slot; unspecified when no conversion was refused.

completed.description: Whether this slice contributes to completed_slices. A final market slice completes even if it traded nothing; a TWAP slice completes only if it traded source input and is over.

executedAt.description: When its first order was sent; unset for an unsent slice.

finishedAt.description: When its outcome became final; unset while planned or executing.

inputTraded.description: Source input traded, in source token units, counting only the first leg.

slicesTruncated.description: True when more than 50 slices exist; only the first 50 are listed. Totals and completed_slices still cover the entire execution.

slicesUnavailableReason.description: Why slice history is unavailable. When set, slices is empty and slices_truncated is false. Counts, execution status and withdrawals remain available, and so do the aggregate amounts, except that with PRECISION_UNAVAILABLE an amount in a token whose precision is unavailable is unset. Unspecified when history is available.

startedAt.description: First actual slice submission. Omitted while every slice is unsent, including refusal during planning; planned times and deadline do not imply submission.

totalSlices.description: Planned slices: a market execution has one once it is planned; a TWAP has its slice count, duration_ms over slice_interval_ms rounded up. Zero until then, and for a bridge, which trades nothing.

feeScheduleVersion.description: Fee schedule version fixed at creation. Every execution or bridge payout of this QuickSwap is charged that version's service fees, capped by the broker's fee ceiling in force at creation if one applies, whatever later versions or ceiling changes make.

fees.description: Broker and affiliate fees as requested, fixed at creation. With a referral (quote.referral), the broker fee charged is broker_bps less the referral's discount and commission.

affiliates.description: Affiliate fees, in ascending account_id order.

accountId.description: Public sub-account ID of an active affiliate vault of the broker (QuickSwapBrokerService.CreateAffiliateVault). Create the vault first: an unknown, disabled or other broker's vault, or the default vault, fails with AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN; an ID that is not a public sub-account ID fails with FEES_INVALID.

bps.description: Fee in basis points of what each leg receives, from 1 to 300.

brokerBps.description: Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, credited to the broker's default vault.

idempotencyKey.description: The broker's idempotency key that created this QuickSwap.

isTerminal.description: True when status is terminal; authoritative, including for status values added later. Polling can stop at a terminal status. A terminal status never changes. Shortly after it, address_retires_at can still move later, and withdrawal details can be corrected as documented on Withdrawal; another deposit reaching the address, before or after it retired, also shows as RETURN_ONLY. Such a deposit is returned directly, not through withdrawals: its direct_return reports the return, and RETURN_ONLY alone does not confirm a completed return. An EXPIRED QuickSwap whose dropped or replaced deposit confirms after all becomes HELD (see QuickSwapStatus.EXPIRED). Read again if the end user reports such a deposit or needs the final retirement time.

quote.description: Quote and protection fixed at creation. Not refreshed on retries. Its amounts and fees stay estimates: the QuickSwap is priced when its deposit is credited, and execution, withdrawals and charged_fees report the actual output and fees.

contingentFees.description: Estimated network fees charged only if funds are not delivered: RETURN_NETWORK, then REFUND_NETWORK when the refund route is known. Not part of fees or expected_amount_out. A partly traded two-leg QuickSwap can be charged both. The fee withheld is the network's fee at payout time. Unlike fees, an entry is never omitted: a known fee of zero is listed with amount "0".

accountId.description: AFFILIATE only: public sub-account ID of the affiliate vault credited with the fee; zero for every other kind, REFERRAL included.

amount.description: Fee in zipped_asset_id's token units; for a trading fee of the first leg of a two-leg route, in the intermediate asset at its trading precision (amount.decimals). A REFUND_NETWORK fee, though paid in the intermediate asset, is in the refund route's token units and precision (0.72 USDT on a 6-decimal route is 720000 with decimals 6). An estimate for deposit_amount at the quoted prices, with trading fees rounded up; the fee charged can be higher or lower.

depositAmount.description: Source amount the quote was computed for, in source token units. Equals the request amount for SOURCE_AMOUNT; computed for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.

expectedAmountOut.description: Expected destination amount for deposit_amount at quoted_at, after trading fees and both quoted network fees, in destination token units. An estimate, not a guarantee: the delivered amount follows the actual deposit, execution and fees, bounded below only by the protection.

expiresAt.description: End of the short quote validity, typically seconds to minutes after quoted_at. Display the quote until expires_at. CreateQuickSwap prices the terms again and never fails because a quote expired. After it the price fields are stale; the protection of a created QuickSwap still applies. Independent of the funding window and the execution deadline.

fees.description: Estimated fee components for deposit_amount at quoted_at: each leg's service, broker and affiliate or referral fees, in that order, legs in route order (a bridge has one set, charged at payout), then network fees. Affiliates are in ascending account_id order. Zero fees are omitted. The fees charged are each rate applied to the actual execution and can differ from these amounts; QuickSwap.charged_fees reports the service, broker, affiliate and referral fees as charged, and Deposit.network_fee and Withdrawal.network_fee the network fees.

Zero for a direct route or a bridge. When non-zero, CreateQuickSwap requires a refund address for that asset. The route is fixed at creation.

maxDepositAmount.description: Largest deposit that is eligible to execute, in source token units, compared with the deposit before its network fee. Fixed when the QuickSwap is created. A larger deposit is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM). Unset for a bridge, whose deposit no order book bounds.
