minAmountOut.description: Guaranteed minimum delivered amount, in destination token units, at the quoted network fees, for a deposit of exactly deposit_amount that fully converts to the destination asset. For any other deposit, and for a deposit only partly converted, the guarantee is min_rate on the converted part.

minDepositAmount.description: Published minimum deposit, in source token units, compared with the deposit before its network fee. Send at least this amount. It is never below the source network's minimum deposit (AssetChainVariant.deposit_min_amount in the config, for DepositInstructions.zipped_asset_id). A smaller deposit is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM) only if it reaches the source network's minimum deposit; a deposit below that minimum is not detected, recorded or returned, and is lost. For a bridge, min_deposit_amount often equals the source network's minimum deposit; when they are equal, any smaller deposit is lost. It differs from ErrorDetail.min_deposit_amount, the smallest deposit that currently quotes. For a TWAP it is the slice count times the smallest deposit one slice takes, and at least a market execution's minimum. The deposit network fee is charged on the actual deposit and can exceed the quoted one: a bridge deposit of at least this amount whose credit after that fee is below one base unit of the destination token is also not executed (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM, see that reason for how its return ends).

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

minRate.description: Guaranteed minimum execution rate: destination display units per source display unit, as a decimal string with at most 18 fractional digits, rounded up when quoted. Guarantee: for the source amount converted all the way to the destination asset, the destination output before the withdrawal network fee is at least that amount × min_rate, rounded down to destination token units. On a two-leg route, the source amount converted is the first leg's input in proportion to the intermediate funds the second leg converted. Source that is not traded is returned to return_address, and intermediate funds that the second leg does not convert are refunded in the intermediate asset to refund_address; those parts are outside the destination guarantee. The amount delivered is the output less the actual withdrawal network fee, which can differ from the quote.

referral.description: The referral applied; set only when the request carried a referral_code. A QuickSwap's quote keeps the referral fixed at creation: later changes to the referral program or partner never change it.

baseBrokerBps.description: Broker fee without the referral: the request's broker_bps.

commissionBps.description: Commission credited to the referral partner.

discountBps.description: Discount off the end user's fee.

reason.description: Why the status is notable (held, returning, delayed, terminal without destination output); REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise. When a payout completes but a refund or return was NOT_SENT, the status follows the paid withdrawals (for example COMPLETED) and the reason is REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM. A FAILED withdrawal takes precedence: the status is HELD and the reason WITHDRAWAL_FAILED.

refundAddress.description: Recipient of refunded intermediate asset; empty when none was supplied.

refundMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for refund_address; empty when none.

refundZippedAssetId.description: Refund route (asset and network) of the intermediate asset; zero when none was supplied.

returnAddress.description: Recipient of returned source funds on the source network.

returnMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for return_address; empty when none.

sourceWallet.description: Source wallet supplied in the request; empty when none was supplied.

terminalAt.description: When status became terminal; unset while not terminal.

amount.description: Positive amount in the token units of the route selected by basis: source route for SOURCE_AMOUNT, destination route for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

basis.description: Side of the swap that amount denominates.

destinationZippedAssetId.description: Destination asset and network: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. The end user receives this asset on this network.

execution.description: Market or TWAP execution. A bridge trades nothing and takes market only; TWAP on a bridge is ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.

durationMs.description: Total execution duration in milliseconds, from 60000 (1 minute) to 86400000 (24 hours). The duration starts when execution starts, not when the QuickSwap is created.

sliceIntervalMs.description: Interval between slices in milliseconds, from 10000 (10 seconds) up to duration_ms. The slice count is duration_ms / slice_interval_ms, rounded up.

protection.description: Worst execution the end user accepts.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum shortfall from the quoted expected output in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 1000. Converted at creation into the quote's min_amount_out and min_rate.

minAmountOut.description: Positive minimum destination amount after fees for the quoted deposit amount, in destination token units. Converted at creation into the quote's min_rate.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

sourceZippedAssetId.description: Source asset and network: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. The end user deposits this asset on this network.

updatedAt.description: When the QuickSwap last changed.

version.description: Monotonic state version: a snapshot with a lower version is older. Zero while ALLOCATING; 1 once the deposit address is issued (AWAITING_DEPOSIT), allocation ends without one (EXPIRED with DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT) or the QuickSwap is REJECTED; every later change increments it.

address.description: Recipient address in the network's native text form. Empty on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, whose recipient Polyester does not record.

amount.description: Amount delivered to address after the network fee, in zipped_asset_id's token units; set once FINALIZED. Like tx_hash, it is the amount recorded for this withdrawal and can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends (terminal_at). Unset on the RETURN of a deposit returned because its risk screen failed (SOURCE_SCREENING_FAILED): that return is sent from the deposit address and reports no delivered amount. Unset on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER too.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

depositIndex.description: Index (Deposit.index), in the same response, of the deposit whose funds this withdrawal moves. Not stable across reads, like Deposit.index.

finalizedAt.description: When the withdrawal became final; unset until FINALIZED.

flowId.description: Public, URL-safe lifecycle flow identifier of this withdrawal, usable with GET /v1/chain/flows/{flow_id}; empty until the flow exists. The flow is the authoritative, latest state of the transfer, including a correction made after tx_hash, amount and network_fee stop being updated. Lifecycle flow amounts are 18-decimal unified units (amount_e18), not token base units. For the RETURN of a deposit returned because its risk screen failed, it is the deposit's flow (Deposit.flow_id), which ends REFUNDED with the return as its transaction. For a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, it is the deposit's flow too, which ends FAILED with reason ZIPPER_COMPLIANCE_TRANSFERRED and the transfer as its transaction.

index.description: Zero-based position in the withdrawals list. Not stable: a withdrawal's position can change between reads, so do not use it as an identifier.

memo.description: Recipient destination tag or memo; empty when the network uses none, and on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER.

networkFee.description: Actual network fee withheld from this withdrawal, in the same units; set once FINALIZED. Can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends, like amount. Unset on the RETURN of a deposit returned because its risk screen failed, and on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, like amount.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for Protection.min_amount_out.

role.description: Why this withdrawal pays its recipient.

submittedAt.description: When the withdrawal was submitted; unset until submitted.

txHash.description: Recipient-network transaction recorded for this withdrawal; empty until the transaction is committed on the recipient network. It can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends (terminal_at) and is not updated after that. For the authoritative, latest state of the transfer, read flow_id.

unsentAmount.description: Set only when state is NOT_SENT: the amount for which no withdrawal was made because it was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and network. In zipped_asset_id's token units, rounded down to the token's smallest unit.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

sourceWallet.description: Optional source wallet the end user will deposit from, as CreateQuickSwapRequest.source_wallet: a valid address on the source network, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. When supplied, it is risk screened before the quote is returned, and a wallet that fails screening is refused with SOURCE_WALLET_REJECTED. Source wallets are screened in advance on Bitcoin, Solana and most EVM networks. Wallets on other networks, including the Bitcoin and Solana test networks, and wallets whose screening is unavailable at the time, are quoted without it; their deposits are still screened on arrival.

minDepositAmount.description: Published minimum deposit, in source token units, compared with the deposit before its network fee. Send at least this amount. It is never below the source network's minimum deposit (AssetChainVariant.deposit_min_amount in the config, for DepositInstructions.zipped_asset_id). A smaller deposit is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM) only if it reaches the source network's minimum deposit; a deposit below that minimum is not detected, recorded or returned, and is lost. For a bridge, min_deposit_amount often equals the source network's minimum deposit; when they are equal, any smaller deposit is lost. It differs from ErrorDetail.min_deposit_amount, the smallest deposit that currently quotes. For a TWAP it is the slice count times the smallest deposit one slice takes, and at least a market execution's minimum. The deposit network fee is charged on the actual deposit and can exceed the quoted one: a bridge deposit of at least this amount whose credit after that fee is below one base unit of the destination token is also not executed (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM, see that reason for how its return ends).

minRate.description: Guaranteed minimum execution rate: destination display units per source display unit, as a decimal string with at most 18 fractional digits, rounded up when quoted. Guarantee: for the source amount converted all the way to the destination asset, the destination output before the withdrawal network fee is at least that amount × min_rate, rounded down to destination token units. On a two-leg route, the source amount converted is the first leg's input in proportion to the intermediate funds the second leg converted. Source that is not traded is returned to return_address, and intermediate funds that the second leg does not convert are refunded in the intermediate asset to refund_address; those parts are outside the destination guarantee. The amount delivered is the output less the actual withdrawal network fee, which can differ from the quote.

causeCode.description: For LADDER_LEVEL_REJECTED, why the refused order of the ladder can't be placed: the code that order would return as a single order, for example MAX_OPEN_ORDERS_PER_PAIR. Omitted for every other code.

code.description: Stable trigger error code.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation using REST field names and decimal quote units for price tick sizes; clients must branch on code.

levelIndex.description: For LADDER_LEVEL_REJECTED, the refused order's zero-based index among the ladder's orders, the i of the violation's trigger.ladder.levels[i], so 0 is the first order. Omitted for every other code.

rateLimit.description: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (HTTP 429) and RATE_LIMIT_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE (HTTP 503) only: the rate-limit decision, with the fields of a batch item error's rateLimit; limit, remaining, retryAfterMs and policyVersion are decimal strings here. A 429 the API gateway answers before the request reaches the service carries only reason (QUOTA_EXCEEDED) and scope (CLIENT_IP). Omitted for every other code.

limit.description: Active weighted quota. Present for the service's RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

operationId.description: Stable operation identifier shared by all aliases of the same action. Present when the service refused the request; absent on the API gateway's own 429.

policyVersion.description: Policy version used for the decision, when available.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason.

refillModel.description: Refill behavior used by the active limiter. Present when the service refused the request; absent on the API gateway's own 429.

remaining.description: Weighted capacity remaining when the request was rejected. Present for the service's RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

retryAfterMs.description: Minimum relative delay before retrying, in milliseconds. Present for the service's RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; on the API gateway's own 429, use the Retry-After header.

scope.description: Caller dimension that owns the exhausted capacity.

maxFutureMs.description: How far a timestamp may run ahead of the server time, in milliseconds: 1000.

recvWindowMs.description: Receive window the timestamp was checked against, in milliseconds: the request's X-API-RECV-WINDOW, or 5000 when the header is omitted.

serverTimeMs.description: Server time when the request was refused, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, as a decimal string.

clientTriggerId.description: Client-provided trigger ID for idempotency, unique per sub-account, pair and trigger type. While the trigger is active and for 60 seconds after it reaches a terminal status, retrying the create with the identical intent returns the same trigger, and a different intent with the same ID returns CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID. After those 60 seconds the ID is free: a create that uses it is a new intent and creates a new trigger. To learn the outcome of an earlier create after that window, find it with the ListTriggers client_trigger_id filter instead of retrying the create. Use a new client trigger ID for every create, so a lookup never finds an older trigger that used the same ID. maxSlippageBps.description: Optional maximum allowed slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

maxSlippageTicks.description: Non-negative maximum absolute price delta in quote units scaled by 1e9 (1e-9 quote units, not the pair's tick size), as set. Zero means no absolute cap is configured.

peakPrice.description: Current peak price for sell trailing stops, as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '61500'.

trailingDistance.description: Trailing distance as a decimal price delta in quote asset units, for example '0.5'.

trailingDistanceBps.description: Trailing distance in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

triggerDirection.description: Direction the price must cross to fire the trigger. Fixed for the lifetime of the trigger and exposed for completeness.

triggerPrice.description: Current trailing trigger threshold as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '60500'. It moves when the peak or trough changes, and is absent until the trailing trigger is armed and a positive threshold exists.

triggerPriceSource.description: Price source used for trigger evaluation. Fixed for the lifetime of the trigger and exposed for completeness.

troughPrice.description: Current trough price for buy trailing stops, as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '59500'.

activationPrice.description: Optional activation price as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '62000'.

limitPrice.description: Maximum price of a trailing stop that buys, as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '63000': the most its child pays per unit. Required when `side` is BUY and set aside for it with the child's fee; at least the activation price, or at least the price it watches (triggerPriceSource) when no activation price is set. A rise that fires above it still fires, and the child fills only at or below it. Must be unset when `side` is SELL. Fixed at create.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 9999 on either side. 10000 is rejected with MAX_SLIPPAGE_INVALID, because a 100% cap would leave a trailing stop that sells no positive price to sell at.

maxSlippageTicks.description: Positive maximum absolute price delta in quote units scaled by 1e9. The "ticks" in this name are 1e-9 quote units, not the pair's tick size, and the value need not be a multiple of the pair's tick size: the child's protection price, the price that fired it moved by this delta, is put on the tick grid toward that price, as for a market order (orders.v1.MarketIoc).

side.description: Child order side. Required.

trailingDistance.description: Trailing distance as a decimal price delta in quote asset units, for example '0.5'.

trailingDistanceBps.description: Distance in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 10000.

triggerPriceSource.description: Price the trailing stop watches: its activation, its peak or trough and its fire all follow this price. Unspecified or LAST_PRICE watches the last traded price. INDEX_PRICE watches the market's index price; a market without an index price fails the trigger with INDEX_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE. MARK_PRICE is not supported. Fixed at create: to change it, cancel the trigger and create a new one.

triggerId.description: Trigger ID.

durationMs.description: Total execution duration in milliseconds, at least 1000.

limitGtc.description: Limit GTC slices with cancel-before-next behavior.

price.description: Slice limit price as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '61000.25'.

marketIoc.description: Server-priced market IOC slices.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum adverse price movement per slice in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 10000. A SELL TWAP accepts values below 10000; a 100% cap would leave a slice no positive price to sell at.

maxSlippageTicks.description: Positive maximum absolute price delta per slice in quote units scaled by 1e9. The "ticks" in this name are 1e-9 quote units, not the pair's tick size, and the value need not be a multiple of the pair's tick size: a slice's protection price, its reference moved by this delta, is put on the tick grid toward that reference, as for a market order (orders.v1.MarketIoc).

side.description: Child side. Required.

sliceIntervalMs.description: Interval between slices in milliseconds, at least 100 and at most duration_ms.

durationMs.description: Total duration of TWAP execution in milliseconds.

executedQty.description: Cumulative filled child-order base quantity as a decimal string in base asset units, for example '0.002'.

sliceIntervalMs.description: Interval between TWAP slices in milliseconds.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp.

version.description: Per-trigger state version: 1 for the trigger's first state, then higher for every later published state change, whether a request or the market caused it. A higher version is always newer, and two copies of a trigger with the same version show the same state. GetTrigger, ListTriggers and realtime trigger updates carry the same version for the same state. List results can briefly lag realtime updates, and after a reconnect or a service recovery a realtime update can repeat an earlier state, so keep the copy of each trigger with the highest version and ignore any copy whose version is not higher than the one you hold.

activationPrice.description: Updated activation price as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '62000'. Set to '0' to clear an existing activation price; omit to leave it unchanged.

limitPrice.description: Not modifiable: a trigger's child limit price is fixed at create. Setting this field rejects the whole request with TRIGGER_CHILD_PRICE_NOT_MODIFIABLE (InvalidArgument, HTTP 400) and leaves the trigger unchanged; cancel the trigger and create a new one to change the child limit price.

maxSlippageBps.description: Updated maximum allowed slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). Set to zero to clear the cap. A buy stop-loss or take-profit with a market child accepts 1 to 10000, as at creation. A trailing stop on either side, and a sell stop-loss or take-profit, accept 1 to 9999: 10000 is rejected with MAX_SLIPPAGE_INVALID, because a 100% cap would leave a sell no positive price, and a trailing stop takes none on either side.

maxSlippageTicks.description: Non-negative maximum absolute price delta in quote units scaled by 1e9 (1e-9 quote units, not the pair's tick size; the value need not be a multiple of the pair's tick size). Set to zero to clear the cap.

trailingDistance.description: Trailing distance as a decimal price delta in quote asset units, for example '0.5'.

trailingDistanceBps.description: Updated trailing distance in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 10000.

amount.description: Withdraw amount as a positive decimal string in whole units of the asset, for example '0.5' for half a unit. At most 18 decimal places; a nonzero digit beyond the 18th is refused. Send the amount itself, not a count of smaller units: '1' withdraws one whole unit. The signed authorization carries amount_e18, this amount times 10^18, so '0.5' is signed as 5 times 10^17. For TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN, the amount has at most as many decimal places as the destination network token (AssetChainVariant.source_decimals); a finer amount is refused with AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_ROUTE_PRECISION before any funds are reserved.

deadlineTsSec.description: Unix timestamp in seconds after which this signed user authorization is no longer accepted by the API. This is separate from the server-owned execution deadline used later for on-chain submission.

destinationAddress.description: Destination address. For TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN this is an address on destination_chain_id and is validated according to that network. For TO_FUNDING, omit it to move funds to the selected account's Funding account or provide another Polyester funding address for a Trading-to-Funding transfer.

destinationChainId.description: Polyester chain id of the destination network for TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN: ChainConfig.chain_id from GetDepositWithdrawConfig, not the network's native chain id (ChainConfig.native_chain_id, such as 11155111 for Ethereum Sepolia). An unknown id is refused with ERROR_CODE_INVALID_DESTINATION_CHAIN. Omit for TO_FUNDING.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen idempotency key. Reusing the same key with the same payload returns the existing withdraw; reusing it with different payload fails.

nonce.description: Client-generated unsigned 128-bit nonce bound to the signed request. This is an identifier, not a decimal amount.

intentId.description: Stable server-owned intent identifier for the accepted withdraw lifecycle. Clients use this id to follow later progress for the same withdraw flow.

deadlineTsSec.description: Unix timestamp in seconds after which the signed batch is no longer accepted, at most 15 minutes ahead.

Retrying with the same key and the same signed batch returns the first answer; reusing it for another batch is refused with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. The first answer stands, after the deadline too. A refused batch is final: a retry under its key answers the same refusal, even once its cause is gone, so a corrected batch needs a new key and signature.

assets.description: Supported unified assets ordered by asset code, each with compatible chain routes.

asset.description: Unified Polyester asset code used inside Funding/Trading (for example: "USDT").

icon.description: Optional icon reference for the unified asset.

quantityDisplayDecimals.description: UI display precision for the unified asset.

quantityScale.description: Integer scale for unified-asset quantities (0..18). A scale of 8 means one whole asset is represented as 100000000 in supply_q and other quantity_scale-based fields.

uAssetId.description: On-chain uAsset id for the unified asset.

depositStatus.description: Whether this route currently accepts new deposits. Omitted while availability is not known; do not treat the route as available then. While it is SUSPENDED, do not send funds to a deposit address on this route; wait until it returns to NORMAL.

Sent only when supplyStatus is AVAILABLE or STALE; a value of '0' then is a real supply of zero. Omitted while no supply is known; never treat a missing supply as zero.

withdrawMinAmount.description: Minimum withdraw amount for this variant as a human-readable string in zToken units.

withdrawalStatus.description: Whether this route currently accepts new withdrawals. Omitted while availability is not known; do not treat the route as available then. A Trading withdrawal accepted before the route became SUSPENDED and not yet sent stays pending, with its funds held, and is sent once the route returns to NORMAL. One already being sent when the suspension takes effect may fail instead; its funds then return to the account.

memoRequirement.description: Memo rule for withdrawal destinations and QuickSwap destination, return, and refund targets on this network. Does not describe deposit instructions.

minAddressLength.description: Inclusive minimum source-chain address length for validation.

nativeCurrencySymbol.description: Native gas token symbol for this chain (for example: ETH, BTC, SOL).

requiredConfirmations.description: Default required source-chain confirmations when known.

contracts.description: Active Polyester-chain contracts ordered by contract name.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DISABLED: Key is temporarily disabled and cannot authenticate requests until re-enabled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REVOKED: Key has been permanently revoked and cannot be used again.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ALL: Allow all current and future markets for this policy.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ALLOWLIST: Allow only the markets listed on this policy.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLAIM_DAILY_REWARD: Allow claiming the main account's daily reward, paid to the main account or a sub-account it owns. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONVERT_DUST: Allow quoting and converting dust, small Trading balances, into a target asset, and reading the conversions. Listing dust balances needs READ_BALANCES.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CREATE_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS: Allow creating a deposit address within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DRAFT_STRATEGIES: Allow validating and storing bot strategy versions, running their behaviour examples, and starting backtests. It never deploys, changes, stops or deletes a bot, and grants no read beyond those calls' answers. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW: Allow value to leave Trading through external withdrawals. Destination authorization is enforced separately from this policy. Moves value out of the account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_TRANSFER: Allow internal transfers between sub-accounts or linked Polyester accounts, including reading internal transfer history. Moves value out of the account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_ADDRESS_BOOK: Allow creating, updating, deleting, and copying saved destination entries, including reading the address book. Address-book writes accept only a session token, so on an API-key policy this grants address-book reads only. It manages where value can leave the account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_API_KEYS: Allow creating, updating and revoking the standard API keys of the main account and of the sub-accounts it owns. Admin permission: honored only for an admin API key, which never manages an admin or assistant key, a key whose policy allows a money-out action, or a sub-account shared with the main account. A key it creates or updates needs an IP allowlist within the admin key's own.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_API_KEY_POLICIES: Allow attaching and clearing the API policies of the standard API keys the admin key may manage. A policy it attaches can never allow a money-out action or an admin permission, and on a sub-account key can never allow more actions or markets than the sub-account's policy. Admin permission: honored only for an admin API key.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_AUTO_WITHDRAW: Allow creating, changing, and disabling the auto-withdraw rule, including reading it. A rule pays value out, so changing one also requires EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW, API keys can never change one, and an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_PRICE_ALERTS: Allow creating, updating, and cancelling the main account's price alerts. It does not allow listing them. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_SUBACCOUNT_POLICIES: Allow attaching, clearing and updating the policies of the sub-accounts the main account owns. The resulting policy can never allow a money-out action, and a locked policy is never changed. Admin permission: honored only for an admin API key.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PROPOSE_STRATEGY_DEPLOY: Allow recording a deploy proposal for a bot strategy version, which the user then deploys on the website with MFA and a wallet signature. It never deploys a bot, creates a subaccount or moves funds. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_ACCOUNT_ACTIVITY: Allow listing the security and activity events of the main account and its sub-accounts within the key's scope: a key scoped to the main account reads all of them, a key scoped to a sub-account only that sub-account's. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_ACCOUNT_DIRECTORY: Allow resolving an account by username, account ID, or smart-account address. Any key of the main account may use it, whatever its scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_ADDRESS_BOOK: Allow reading saved, recent, and whitelisted address-book destinations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_API_KEYS: Allow listing and reading API keys. A key scoped to the main account sees the main account's keys and those of its sub-accounts; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only that sub-account's keys. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_API_POLICIES: Allow listing and reading API-key policies. A key scoped to the main account sees every API-key policy of the main account; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only the policies attached to that sub-account's keys. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_AUTO_WITHDRAW: Allow reading the auto-withdraw rule and its runs.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_BALANCES: Allow reading balances and equity for a sub-account or API key.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_CHECKPOINTS: Allow reading the main account's checkpoints. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_DAILY_CLAIMS: Allow reading the main account's daily reward claim status. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_DEPOSIT_ADDRESSES: Allow listing the deposit addresses within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_FUNDING_FLOWS: Allow reading the account's deposit, withdrawal, and transfer flows, including the flows no chain transaction started and the transfers it receives from other accounts. It grants no balance or transfer read.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_GUARD_SIGNER_STATUS: Allow reading the Guard Signer status within the key's scope; a key never reads another main account's Guard Signer. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_NOTIFICATIONS: Allow listing, reading, and counting the main account's notifications. It does not allow marking them read or unread. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_PNL: Allow reading the account's profit and loss: realized and unrealized PnL, holdings with their entry price, trading statistics and the daily series. It grants no balance or trade read. Like READ_BALANCES, it is part of every sub-account's read floor.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_PRICE_ALERTS: Allow listing the main account's price alerts. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_PROFILE: Allow reading the main account's profile and username history. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_REWARDS: Allow reading the main account's published reward awards. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SOCIAL_VERIFICATION: Allow reading the main account's social verification status: provider, handle, status, and verification time. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SPOT: Allow reading spot orders and trades, subscriptions, and cancel-all dry-run. Strictly non-mutating: cancellation and cancel-all-after changes require TRADE_SPOT.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_STATEMENTS: Allow exporting account statements: the account's balance movements for a period, with fees and the balance after each entry. It grants no other balance or transfer read.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_STRATEGIES: Allow reading the main account's bot strategies: their versions, backtests, review summaries, deploy proposals, bots and bot logs. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNTS: Allow listing and reading the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_ACTIVITY: Allow reading the activity of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_INVITES: Allow listing the outgoing invites of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_MEMBERS: Allow listing the members of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSIONS: Allow reading what the key itself may do on a sub-account within its scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_POLICIES: Allow listing and reading sub-account policies. A key scoped to the main account sees every sub-account policy of the main account; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only the policy attached to that sub-account. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_VIP_STATUS: Allow reading the main account's VIP status. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_WITHDRAW_VALIDATION: Allow validating an external withdraw destination within the key's scope without creating, signing, or reserving a withdraw. It does not allow withdrawing. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STOP_STRATEGIES: Allow stopping the main account's bots, keeping or cancelling their orders. Stopping only reduces what a bot does: it never deploys a bot, changes its money rules or moves funds. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SWAP: Allow quoting, creating, and reading Swaps: market conversions of the account's own Trading balance from one asset into another. Each Swap places spot orders on the account's behalf, which also remain subject to the sub-account's spot trading policy.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADE_SPOT: Allow all spot order mutations: create, modify, replace, cancel, batch operations, live cancel-all, and arming or disabling cancel-all-after. Includes reading spot orders and trades and placing or modifying triggers. Authorized cancellation remains available when trading activity is disabled; this does not grant mutation access to a read-only API key.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLAIM_DAILY_REWARD: Allow claiming the main account's daily reward, paid to the main account or a sub-account it owns. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONVERT_DUST: Allow quoting and converting dust, small Trading balances, into a target asset, and reading the conversions. Listing dust balances needs READ_BALANCES.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CREATE_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS: Allow creating a deposit address within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DRAFT_STRATEGIES: Allow validating and storing bot strategy versions, running their behaviour examples, and starting backtests. It never deploys, changes, stops or deletes a bot, and grants no read beyond those calls' answers. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW: Allow value to leave Trading through external withdrawals. Destination authorization is enforced separately from this policy. Moves value out of the account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_TRANSFER: Allow internal transfers between sub-accounts or linked Polyester accounts, including reading internal transfer history. Moves value out of the account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_ADDRESS_BOOK: Allow creating, updating, deleting, and copying saved destination entries, including reading the address book. Address-book writes accept only a session token, so on an API-key policy this grants address-book reads only. It manages where value can leave the account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_API_KEYS: Allow creating, updating and revoking the standard API keys of the main account and of the sub-accounts it owns. Admin permission: honored only for an admin API key, which never manages an admin or assistant key, a key whose policy allows a money-out action, or a sub-account shared with the main account. A key it creates or updates needs an IP allowlist within the admin key's own.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_API_KEY_POLICIES: Allow attaching and clearing the API policies of the standard API keys the admin key may manage. A policy it attaches can never allow a money-out action or an admin permission, and on a sub-account key can never allow more actions or markets than the sub-account's policy. Admin permission: honored only for an admin API key.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_AUTO_WITHDRAW: Allow creating, changing, and disabling the auto-withdraw rule, including reading it. A rule pays value out, so changing one also requires EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW, API keys can never change one, and an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_PRICE_ALERTS: Allow creating, updating, and cancelling the main account's price alerts. It does not allow listing them. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_SUBACCOUNT_POLICIES: Allow attaching, clearing and updating the policies of the sub-accounts the main account owns. The resulting policy can never allow a money-out action, and a locked policy is never changed. Admin permission: honored only for an admin API key.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PROPOSE_STRATEGY_DEPLOY: Allow recording a deploy proposal for a bot strategy version, which the user then deploys on the website with MFA and a wallet signature. It never deploys a bot, creates a subaccount or moves funds. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_ACCOUNT_ACTIVITY: Allow listing the security and activity events of the main account and its sub-accounts within the key's scope: a key scoped to the main account reads all of them, a key scoped to a sub-account only that sub-account's. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_ACCOUNT_DIRECTORY: Allow resolving an account by username, account ID, or smart-account address. Any key of the main account may use it, whatever its scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_ADDRESS_BOOK: Allow reading saved, recent, and whitelisted address-book destinations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_API_KEYS: Allow listing and reading API keys. A key scoped to the main account sees the main account's keys and those of its sub-accounts; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only that sub-account's keys. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_API_POLICIES: Allow listing and reading API-key policies. A key scoped to the main account sees every API-key policy of the main account; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only the policies attached to that sub-account's keys. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_AUTO_WITHDRAW: Allow reading the auto-withdraw rule and its runs.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_BALANCES: Allow reading balances and equity for a sub-account or API key.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_CHECKPOINTS: Allow reading the main account's checkpoints. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_DAILY_CLAIMS: Allow reading the main account's daily reward claim status. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_DEPOSIT_ADDRESSES: Allow listing the deposit addresses within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_FUNDING_FLOWS: Allow reading the account's deposit, withdrawal, and transfer flows, including the flows no chain transaction started and the transfers it receives from other accounts. It grants no balance or transfer read.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_GUARD_SIGNER_STATUS: Allow reading the Guard Signer status within the key's scope; a key never reads another main account's Guard Signer. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_NOTIFICATIONS: Allow listing, reading, and counting the main account's notifications. It does not allow marking them read or unread. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_PNL: Allow reading the account's profit and loss: realized and unrealized PnL, holdings with their entry price, trading statistics and the daily series. It grants no balance or trade read. Like READ_BALANCES, it is part of every sub-account's read floor.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_PRICE_ALERTS: Allow listing the main account's price alerts. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_PROFILE: Allow reading the main account's profile and username history. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_REWARDS: Allow reading the main account's published reward awards. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SOCIAL_VERIFICATION: Allow reading the main account's social verification status: provider, handle, status, and verification time. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SPOT: Allow reading spot orders and trades, subscriptions, and cancel-all dry-run. Strictly non-mutating: cancellation and cancel-all-after changes require TRADE_SPOT.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_STATEMENTS: Allow exporting account statements: the account's balance movements for a period, with fees and the balance after each entry. It grants no other balance or transfer read.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_STRATEGIES: Allow reading the main account's bot strategies: their versions, backtests, review summaries, deploy proposals, bots and bot logs. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNTS: Allow listing and reading the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_ACTIVITY: Allow reading the activity of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_INVITES: Allow listing the outgoing invites of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_MEMBERS: Allow listing the members of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSIONS: Allow reading what the key itself may do on a sub-account within its scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_POLICIES: Allow listing and reading sub-account policies. A key scoped to the main account sees every sub-account policy of the main account; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only the policy attached to that sub-account. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_VIP_STATUS: Allow reading the main account's VIP status. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_WITHDRAW_VALIDATION: Allow validating an external withdraw destination within the key's scope without creating, signing, or reserving a withdraw. It does not allow withdrawing. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STOP_STRATEGIES: Allow stopping the main account's bots, keeping or cancelling their orders. Stopping only reduces what a bot does: it never deploys a bot, changes its money rules or moves funds. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SWAP: Allow quoting, creating, and reading Swaps: market conversions of the account's own Trading balance from one asset into another. Each Swap places spot orders on the account's behalf, which also remain subject to the sub-account's spot trading policy.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADE_SPOT: Allow all spot order mutations: create, modify, replace, cancel, batch operations, live cancel-all, and arming or disabling cancel-all-after. Includes reading spot orders and trades and placing or modifying triggers. Authorized cancellation remains available when trading activity is disabled; this does not grant mutation access to a read-only API key.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE: The sub-account can be used normally.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DISABLED: The sub-account is disabled and cannot be used until re-enabled.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BIWEEKLY: Every two weeks on weekday at minute_of_day UTC: in the week of anchor_date and every second week before or after it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DAILY: Once a day at minute_of_day UTC.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.HOURLY: Checked every hour at minute_of_hour UTC; pays only an asset whose payable amount has reached its minimums, so a payout follows within the hour of the balance reaching them. An hour with nothing to pay records no run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MONTHLY: Once a month on day_of_month at minute_of_day UTC. A month without that day runs on its last day: day 31 runs on April 30 and on February 28 or 29, and days 29 and 30 run on the last day of February.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WEEKLY: Once a week on weekday at minute_of_day UTC.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.NO_DESTINATION: Nothing would pay, and every positive balance is in an asset the rule has no destination for.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAUSED: The rule is paused, by a person or by itself (see pause); no run starts until it is resumed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ROLLS_OVER: Nothing would pay: every asset with a destination is below its minimum or the rule's USD minimum, has no current price for that minimum, or pays a broker vault's destination that is still cooling down. The balance stays on the account for a later run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WILL_PAY: At least one asset would pay.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLETED: Every payout completed or was skipped, and at least one paid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONVERTING: The run's conversions into the payout asset are executing; payouts start once every conversion is final and settled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Every attempted payout failed. Each failed step says where its funds are (FAILED).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARTIALLY_FAILED: Some payouts failed. Each failed step says where its funds are (FAILED).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYING: The run's payouts are in progress.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PLANNED: The run is reading the account's balances.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SKIPPED: Nothing was paid: every asset was below its minimum, no current price valued it, or the rule was no longer current.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: The withdrawal failed. Where its funds are depends on when it failed, which its withdrawal flow shows: - before it left the account: they stay on the account; - rejected by Zipper (flow REFUNDED, reason ZIPPER_VALIDATION_REJECTED or ZIPPER_EXECUTION_REJECTED): amount_e18 less network_fee_e18 is refunded, as zTokens, to the account's smart account wallet, not to the account's balance, and the network fee is not refunded; - its execution failed after its destination transaction was sent (flow FAILED, reason ZIPPER_WITHDRAW_EXECUTION_FAILED): Zipper reviews it and settles it outside Polyester Chain; nothing is returned to the account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SKIPPED: Nothing was paid for this asset in this run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBMITTED: Withdrawal accepted; waiting for it to complete on chain.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_BALANCE: The balance read returned a value that is not a valid balance.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NO_CONTRACT: No zToken contract exists at the listed address on Polyester Chain.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_FAILED: Polyester Chain answered the balance read with an error.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DENYLISTED_ADDRESS: The destination is blocked by Polyester's user-safety denylist.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ADDRESS: The address is not valid for the selected destination chain.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLYESTER_SMART_ACCOUNT: The destination is a Polyester smart account and cannot be used for an external-chain withdraw.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SWAP_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS: The destination is a deposit address issued for a QuickSwap. A withdrawal could reach it after its swap stopped accepting deposits, and those funds could then be neither swapped nor returned, so it is never a withdrawal destination. A Polyester account's own deposit address is not affected.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TOKEN_CONTRACT: The destination is a token contract and cannot receive withdrawals.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN: The selected destination chain is not supported for withdraws.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.VALID: The destination is valid and may be used for a withdraw.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_SUPPORTED: A memo or destination tag must be empty.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OPTIONAL: A memo or destination tag may be supplied.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REQUIRED: A memo or destination tag must be supplied.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUSPENDED: The route does not accept new requests. Do not send funds on it until it returns to NORMAL.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.AVAILABLE: The supply was read from Polyester chain recently and is current.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MISSING: No supply is known for the route yet. No supply value or observation time is sent; do not treat the route's supply as zero.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STALE: The supply value is the last one read, but it has not been refreshed for longer than expected and may no longer be accurate. Do not size a withdrawal against it as if it were current.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.AHEAD: Available in the environment while its release is still pending there.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PENDING: Not yet available in the environment although its release is live there.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNAVAILABLE: Not available in the environment for now, whatever its release's status.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BREAKING_CHANGE: Breaking change: existing integrations may need to change.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ASSISTANT: The AI assistant: chats, approvals, memories and preferences.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_DATA: Market data: prices, candles, order book, heatmaps and market overviews.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REWARDS: Rewards: daily claims, campaigns, VIP tiers and fee discounts.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADING: Orders, triggers and protective orders, and order outcomes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADING_BOTS: Trading bots: strategies you build, backtest and share, and bots running them live.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.UTC_DAILY: One claim is available to each root account per UTC calendar day.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.AVAILABLE: Today's reward is available to claim.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_DELAYED: Today's claim is recorded but its payout is delayed. It is retried and paid automatically; the payout delay reason gives the cause.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PROCESSING: Today's claim is being processed. Retrying returns the same claim.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNAVAILABLE: No reward is active for the current UTC day.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLAIM_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Today's claim is recorded and its reward payout was submitted, but its result could not be confirmed. The claim is never paid twice: read the claim status, or retry the claim to get its current state. The error detail names the claim.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLAIM_PAYOUT_UNAVAILABLE: Reward payouts for this campaign are paused. Today's claim is kept and paid automatically once payouts resume.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLAIM_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: The claim reward is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLAIM_UNAVAILABLE: No reward is available for the current UTC day.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT: The request encountered concurrent claim activity. Retry the request.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED_PRECONDITION: A required condition for completing the claim was not satisfied.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: The request failed because of an unexpected server error.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PERMISSION_DENIED: The claim request was not permitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The applicable request rate limit was exceeded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: The REST request body exceeds the 1 KiB limit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unable to complete the request.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SOCIAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Verify an X or Discord account before claiming a reward.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBACCOUNT_INACTIVE: The selected subaccount is owned by the authenticated root account but is not active.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: The selected subaccount does not exist or is not owned by the authenticated root account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNAUTHENTICATED: The request carries no valid session token or API-key signature.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_ADDRESS: External wallet or chain address. The address is lifecycle-derived and may be empty until ledger-to-lifecycle correlation is projected.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ACCOUNT: Fee ledger side, for example spot or perp trading fees.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRIVATE_COUNTERPARTY: Private off-chain counterparty that must not be identified to the caller. account_id and address are intentionally omitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SYSTEM_ACCOUNT: System, operator, clearing, or other non-user side.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.deposit: External deposit into a funding account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.dust_convert: Dust conversion leg: a source asset's whole dust amount debited from the Trading account, or the target asset's payout credited after the fee. The fee is taken from the payout, not booked as a separate transfer; see transfer.v1.DustConversionService for the gross amount and fee.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.fee_refill: Funds transferred from the fee treasury's trading account to replenish fee funds.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.fee_sweep: Collected fees transferred to the fee treasury's trading account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.funding_opening_balance: Opening balance of a funding account: the balance it held on Polyester Chain when the account's transfer history starts, credited from a system account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.internal_batch: One leg of an all-or-nothing batch of internal transfers between Trading accounts: credited together with the batch's other legs. Legs of one batch share its batch reference.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.maker_fee: Maker fee charged for a trade.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.quickswap_affiliate_fee: QuickSwap fee paid to an affiliate in the received asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.quickswap_broker_fee: QuickSwap fee paid to a broker in the received asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.quickswap_polyester_fee: QuickSwap fee paid to Polyester in the received asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.system_adjustment: Balance adjustment with a system account, including account seeding credits or corrections. May credit or debit the user's account; the transfer direction identifies which.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.taker_fee: Taker fee charged for a trade.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.trading_withdraw_fee_leg: Fee paid to a fee recipient when a trading withdrawal completes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.trading_withdraw_request_fee: Debit of a withdrawal from the Trading account that Zipper rejected or that failed to execute: the whole amount sent to Zipper for it, the request fee included. The withdrawal's other fees are not charged. A rejected withdrawal refunds that amount, less the request fee, to the user's own wallet; one that failed to execute is not refunded, and Zipper settles it with the user outside Polyester Chain. A withdrawal from the Funding account uses withdraw_failed instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.trading_withdraw_reserve: Reserve leg for a trading withdrawal.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.withdraw: External withdrawal from a funding account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.withdraw_failed: Debit of a withdrawal from the Funding account that Zipper rejected or that failed to execute: the whole amount that left the account for it. A rejected withdrawal refunds that amount, less the request fee, to the user's own wallet; one that failed to execute is not refunded, and Zipper settles it with the user outside Polyester Chain. A withdrawal from the Trading account uses trading_withdraw_request_fee instead.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.COINMARKETCAP: Supplied by CoinMarketCap. Show "Source: CoinMarketCap" with the value.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ENABLED: New orders and cancellations are accepted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.HALTED: Trading is halted: only cancellations are accepted, and new orders are rejected with MARKET_HALTED.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY: New orders must use a post-only execution variant.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REDUCE_ONLY: New spot orders are blocked by reduce-only policy.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.INDEX_PRICE: The pair's index price, on the tick grid: the reference moves there when the candidate reference lies outside the band around the index price.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LAST_TRADE: The price of the pair's last trade.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LISTING_REFERENCE: The pair's listing reference price, on a pair that has not traded yet.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE: The band is on and at least one price lies inside it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EMPTY: The band is on and no price lies inside it: every order that adds exposure, market orders included, is rejected with PRICE_BAND_VIOLATION until the reference price or the band's settings change. This is not a trading halt.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OFF: The pair applies no price band.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN: No band was confirmed current within the last 5 seconds: do not rely on the band received before. Only the price band streams send it, once, when the band lapses; GetPriceBand answers PRICE_BAND_STALE or PRICE_BAND_UNKNOWN instead, which means the same. An UNKNOWN band has no prices, reference source or settings. Its epoch, update ID and as-of time are those of the last confirmation of the band it replaces, 0 when there was none, and its update and valid-until times equal its as-of time. Keep the band with the greatest epoch, then update ID, then as-of time; at an equal one, UNKNOWN replaces the band, and a later confirmation replaces UNKNOWN.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BUY: Return trades where the taker/aggressor was buying the base asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SELL: Return trades where the taker/aggressor was selling the base asset.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DATE_ADDED: Sort by listing time (new listings first).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LAST_PRICE: Sort by last price in quote units scaled by 1e9.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.VOLUME_24H_USD: Sort by canonical USD 24h volume. Unvalued markets sort last in either direction.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.1h: 1 hour sparkline. Typically returns up to 60 points (1-minute buckets).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.1mo: 1 month sparkline. Typically returns up to 180 points (4-hour buckets).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.1w: 1 week sparkline. Typically returns up to 168 points (1-hour buckets).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.24h: 24 hour sparkline. Typically returns up to 96 points (15-minute buckets).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_CONFIGURED: No leg configured on the parent order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RUNNING: Trigger is executing runtime work (for example multi-step workflows).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCEPTED: The cancellation request was accepted for processing.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ADMITTED: Every requested operation was admitted, amended items included.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARTIALLY_ADMITTED: Some requested replacements were admitted and others were rejected.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ADMITTED: The operation was admitted and handed to execution. action_taken tells whether the order was amended under its own order ID or replaced by a successor.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REJECTED: The replacement was rejected before execution handoff.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ARMED: The dead-man switch is armed or refreshed.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.INCLUDED: The initial response includes its listing, possibly empty, up to 200 orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_RETAINED_READ_OPEN_ORDERS: A retry returns its original outcome and counts without the historical listing. Read open orders for current state and use order updates for final outcomes. No new cancellations are requested by the retry.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DRY_RUN: The request only counted matching orders and submitted no cancellations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBMITTED: Matching cancellation requests were submitted for processing.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCEPTED: The cancellation request was accepted for processing.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_REPAIR: Canceled by the exchange while it recovered the account. Place new orders once the account trades again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_EXIT_FIRED: The order's attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop fired while the order still rested: the exchange canceled the order's unfilled remainder before placing the attached order, so the two never trade with each other. Fills before the cancel stand.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_RISK_REFUSED: The market refused one of the order's attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing-stop legs, so the order's remainder and its other legs were canceled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_ALL_AFTER: The account's cancel-all-after timer reached its deadline without a heartbeat.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_ON_DISCONNECT: Cancel-on-disconnect canceled the order: the trading WebSocket connections of the account that opted in to cancel-on-disconnect all closed, and no session of the account opted in again before each one's grace period passed. An order the account's own cancel-all-after timer canceled reads CANCEL_ALL_AFTER instead. Fills before the cancel stand.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.GTD_EXPIRED: A good-till-date order reached its expiry time.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.IOC_REMAINDER: The unfilled remainder of an immediate-or-cancel order. A buy sized by a quote amount (max_quote_debit_scaled) that spends that amount, or a sell sized by a quote proceeds target (quote_proceeds_scaled) that receives it, ends FILLED instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_HALTED: The market was halted: the exchange canceled every open order of the market. Fills before the cancel stand. The market refuses new orders until it trades again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_REMAINDER: The unfilled remainder of a market order: the book ran out, the next price was past the order's protection price, or the order reached the market's maximum order quantity. A market buy sized by a quote amount (max_quote_debit_scaled) that spends that amount, so that what is left buys no further quantity step, ends FILLED instead, as does a market sell sized by a quote proceeds target (quote_proceeds_scaled) once what is left of the target sells no further quantity step.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DRAIN: The market was disabled: the exchange canceled its resting orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_BAND: The market's price band stopped the order: it filled up to the band's limit price, and its unfilled remainder was canceled rather than trade beyond the band. Fills before the cancel stand.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QTY_AT_OR_BELOW_FILLED: An amend or replace set the order's total quantity at or below its filled quantity, so the order ended at its filled quantity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REPLACED: A replace ended this order and created its successor.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STP_DECREMENT: Self-trade prevention mode DECREMENT reduced this order to its filled quantity: an incoming order met a resting order belonging to the same root account, including another subaccount of that root, both were reduced by the quantity that would have traded, with no trade, and this order had no quantity left. Fills before the cancel stand.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STP_EXPIRE_BOTH: Self-trade prevention canceled both this order and the order belonging to the same root account, including another subaccount of that root, that it would have matched.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STP_EXPIRE_MAKER: Self-trade prevention canceled this resting order when an incoming order belonging to the same root account, including another subaccount of that root, would have matched it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STP_EXPIRE_TAKER: Self-trade prevention canceled this incoming order instead of matching a resting order belonging to the same root account, including another subaccount of that root.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STRATEGY_CANCEL: An order a trigger placed, such as a TWAP slice, a ladder level, a stop's child or an attached leg's exit, canceled because its trigger ended or another leg took over the exit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SYSTEM: The exchange canceled the order for a reason it does not name.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP_ROLLOVER: A TWAP slice its TWAP canceled at the next slice's due time; its unfilled remainder moves to the TWAP's later slices.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.USER_REQUEST: A cancel the account sent: a cancel, a batch cancel or a cancel-all.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_ORDERS_SUSPENDED: New orders, changes and trigger orders on this account are suspended until a balance issue is resolved; cancels still work. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_REPAIRING: This account's orders are being canceled while its balances are brought back in line, so new orders, changes and trigger orders are paused for a short time. Nothing changed; cancels still work. Try again shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_RESERVATION_LIMIT_REACHED: The account's open orders and triggers hold its maximum number of fund reservations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_ROUTING_INVALID: The account's trading route is not configured for triggers, so the trigger was not admitted. Contact support if it persists.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN: Referenced account could not be resolved by the trading service.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_MARKET_DENY: API key policy does not allow trading this market, even though the sub-account policy does.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_POLICY_REQUIRED: The API key has no policy, so it has no permissions: attach a policy to the API key that grants what it needs.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_ROOT_SCOPE_ONLY: API key is scoped to the root account and cannot trade on sub-accounts.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SPOT_READ_DENY: API key policy does not grant READ_SPOT.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SPOT_TRADE_DENY: The API key's policy does not allow spot trading: enable TRADE_SPOT (Spot Trading Write) on the API key's policy. When both the key's and the sub-account's policies lack it, the key is named first.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SUBACCOUNT_MISMATCH: API key is scoped to a different sub-account than the one requested.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SUB_SCOPE_ONLY: API key is scoped to a specific sub-account and cannot trade on the root account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_UNKNOWN: The API key in the request, or its policy, could not be found.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_EXIT_WORKING: An exit order placed by one of the order's attached take-profit or stop legs is still working, so the order's attached legs can't be added, edited, paused or resumed now; removing a leg is still accepted. Nothing changed; retry once the exit completes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_LEGS_EXCEEDED: The order already carries every attached leg it may hold, so another attached leg was refused. Legs being cancelled count until they end: retry once they have ended.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_RISK_NOT_SUPPORTED: Attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing legs can't be applied to this order: it was placed by a triggered take-profit, stop-loss or trailing-stop leg, or replaces such an order, and it can't carry legs of its own. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BAD_PRICE: Price is invalid for the requested order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BAD_QTY: Quantity is invalid for the requested order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BAD_REQUEST: Request could not be parsed or was structurally invalid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_OTHER_ITEM_INVALID: Another item of the same BatchReplaceOrders batch was invalid, so this item was not applied either. Nothing in the batch changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_REPLACE_ONLY_REQUIRED: No longer returned: each BatchReplaceOrders item follows ModifyOrder's default amend-or-replace rule. The value stays reserved.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_SINGLE_SYMBOL_REQUIRED: An item of the batch modify named no symbol, or another symbol than the batch's first item, so the batch was refused.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_TOO_LARGE: Batch size exceeds the maximum allowed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_ALL_AFTER_SCOPE_CONFLICT: A cancel-all-after is already due to fire, and the re-arm's scope does not cover every symbol of the pending one.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_ALL_AFTER_TIMEOUT_INVALID: The cancel-all-after timeout is neither 0, which disarms it, nor between 10 and 120 seconds.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_REQUEST_EXPIRED: The cancel-all request arrived after its acceptance window of about two minutes had passed, so nothing was canceled. Send a new request with a fresh request_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE: The cancel-all request named more than 100 symbols.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CHILD_ORDER_INCONSISTENT: The trigger's child order did not match the order the trigger requested, so the trigger failed and the child order was canceled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CHILD_QTY_EXCEEDS_REMAINING: The new quantity of a TWAP order's slice would leave more than the TWAP's remaining quantity. Nothing changed; a slice can be raised up to what the TWAP still has to execute.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CHILD_QTY_RAISE_NOT_ALLOWED: A ladder level or the exit order of a take-profit, stop-loss or trailing leg can't be raised above its cap. Nothing changed. A ladder level's cap is its planned quantity, even after the level was reduced. An exit order's cap is its current quantity: reducing an exit returns the reduced quantity to the legs that protect the position.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_LIST_ID_INVALID: The OCO's client list ID is empty, longer than 36 characters, or has a character other than a letter, digit, period, underscore, colon, slash or hyphen. Answered by CreateOco and by the ListTriggers client_list_id filter. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_ORDER_IDS_EXHAUSTED: The account reserves its maximum number of client order IDs, including those of recently ended orders. Retry once they expire, or send the request without a client order ID.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_ORDER_ID_CAPACITY_REACHED: The venue's capacity for reserved client order IDs is exhausted right now, so the trigger's child order could not reserve one. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID_INVALID: The client trigger ID is empty, longer than 36 bytes or otherwise not valid. Answered by CreateTrigger and by the ListTriggers client_trigger_id filter.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONDITION_FLAGS_INVALID: The trigger's condition flags were not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONDITION_PARAMETER_SET: The trigger set a condition parameter its condition does not take.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_ORDER_ID: Client order ID is already in use on this account, by an open order or by an order that ended recently; an ended order keeps its client order ID reserved for at least 60 seconds. Reuse returns this code even with the same payload. Use GetOrder to reconcile, then retry with a new client order ID.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID: Client trigger ID is already used, either by a trigger with a different payload or by an earlier create that failed or was rolled back. List triggers to reconcile by client trigger ID, then retry with a new client trigger ID.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE: Idempotency key was reused with a different payload.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DRY_RUN_INVALID: The cancel-all request's dry-run flag was neither 0 nor 1.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID: The order identifier assigned to the request is already in use by another order of the market. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EMPTY_BOOK: Market order could not execute due to empty book.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ASSET_INVALID: The trigger's fee asset was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ASSET_NOT_ALLOWED: Requested fee asset is not allowed for this order or trigger: BASE on a SELL, or BASE on a BUY where the pair's allow_buy_fee_from_base is false.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_CEILING_INVALID: The trigger's maximum fee rate was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE: The fees that apply to the order cannot be determined right now, so it was not admitted. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FOK_INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY: FOK order rejected due to insufficient immediate liquidity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.GATEWAY_MISCONFIGURED: The endpoint that took the request is misconfigured. Retrying does not help; contact support. Not currently returned.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ICEBERG_DISPLAY_INVALID: The iceberg display quantity is not below the order's quantity, or is not a multiple of the pair's quantity step. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ICEBERG_DISPLAY_TOO_SMALL: The iceberg display quantity is below the pair's minimum order quantity, or splits the order's quantity into more than 100 parts: it must be at least the order's quantity divided by 100, rounded up. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ICEBERG_NOT_ALLOWED: A display quantity was set on an order that cannot be an iceberg order. Only good-till-cancelled and good-till-date limit orders without attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop orders can be iceberg orders. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: Account does not have enough available balance for the order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTENT_ID_INVALID: The cancel-all or cancel-all-after request carried an intent identifier of zero.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: Order processing failed because of an unexpected error.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CLIENT_ORDER_ID: The client order ID is longer than 36 bytes or otherwise not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_HANDLING_MODE: The order handling mode is not a known or accepted mode.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MODIFY_BEHAVIOR: The modify behavior is not a known behavior.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_FLAGS: An order flag is unknown, or not accepted with this order type or time in force, or on a trigger's child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_ID: The order identifier or the replacement order identifier is not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_TYPE: The order type, or a trigger's child order type, is not a known order type.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PEG: Entry peg has an invalid reference or unsupported combination.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SIDE: The order side, or a trigger's child order side, is not a known side.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_STP_MODE: The self-trade prevention mode is not a known mode.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TIME_IN_FORCE: The time in force, or its expiry time, is not accepted for this order or for a trigger's child order type.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TRIGGER_CONTROL: The requested trigger operation is not a known operation.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TRIGGER_TYPE: The trigger type is not a known type.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER_LEVELS_INVALID: A ladder places from 2 to 100 orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER_LEVEL_REJECTED: One of the ladder's orders can't be placed, so the ladder was not created. Nothing changed.
